title: MemTrial: Learning When to Trust Memory in LLM Portfolio Agents
title_zh: MemTrial: Learning When to Trust Memory in LLM Portfolio Agents

paragraphs.en: obeypunctuation=true] University of Technology Sydney
paragraphs.zh: 悉尼科技大学

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents for portfolio management learn from experience: they credit each experience in their memory with the outcome of the decisions that used it. In financial markets, however, this outcome mostly reflects the market move shared by all decisions on that date, so the credit tracks the market rather than the experience, and these agents often do worse than simply holding the equal-weight (1/ N N ) portfolio. We ask how an agent can measure what an experience changes, and answer by putting memory on trial: drafts of the same decision with and without an experience face the same market, so the outcome they share cancels in their difference. Our agent, MemTrial, generates eight drafts of each decision with subsets of its retrieved experiences chosen by a fractional factorial design, and estimates each experience’s contribution as its Banzhaf value, the average of these differences. As each date occurs once and each draft is a noisy LLM sample, these contributions are noisy and may not hold on unseen dates. MemTrial therefore pools them into values across dates and similar experiences with a hierarchical Bayesian model, acts on the values only after they have predicted unseen dates, and otherwise stays anchored at a conservative reference such as 1/ N N . On four benchmarks, it not only benefits from experiences that matter (the best of 15 methods on a semi-synthetic benchmark with known experience quality) but also, through its anchor, limits its losses when its values do not hold (at most 2.2% below 1/ N N on PortBench and InvestorBench, against 15–38% for the best experience-learning agent). Averaged over five benchmark settings, its utility is 21.2% higher than that of the best experience-learning agent, and with eight LLMs it beats every LLM-based baseline on InvestorBench. Our code is available here .
paragraphs.zh: 用于投资组合管理的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能够从经验中学习：它们会将每次决策所依据的经验，与使用该经验所做的决策所产生的结果相关联。 然而，在金融市场中，这种结果主要反映的是该日期所有决策共同面临的市场变动，因此这种关联追踪的是市场而非具体经验，导致这些智能体的表现通常不如简单持有等权重（1/N）投资组合。 我们提出一个问题：智能体如何衡量某次经验所带来的变化？我们的答案是让记忆接受检验：将包含和不包含该经验的同一决策草案置于相同的市场环境中，这样它们共同面对的市场结果便可以在差异中被抵消。 我们的智能体 MemTrial 会针对每个决策生成八份草案，这些草案基于通过分数因子设计选出的部分已检索经验，并估算每次经验的贡献度——即其班扎夫值（Banzhaf value），也就是这些差异的平均值。 由于每个日期仅出现一次，且每份草案都是带有噪声的 LLM 样本，因此这些贡献度本身也存在噪声，并且可能无法在未见过的日期上持续有效。 因此，MemTrial 采用分层贝叶斯模型，将这些贡献度按日期和相似经验进行汇总，仅在预测结果覆盖未见过的日期后才会据此采取行动，否则则会锚定在 1/N 等保守参考策略上。 在四个基准测试中，它不仅能够从真正重要的经验中获益（在半合成基准测试中，已知经验质量的情况下，其表现优于 15 种方法中的最佳方法），还通过锚定机制限制了自身损失——当预测失效时，其在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上的最大跌幅仅为 1/ N 的 2.2%，而最佳经验学习智能体的跌幅则高达 15%–38%。 在五个基准测试设置中的平均表现来看，其效用比最佳经验学习智能体高出 21.2%；而在使用八台 LLM 的情况下，它在 InvestorBench 上击败了所有基于 LLM 的基线模型。 我们的代码可在此处获取。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents are increasingly used to manage investment portfolios ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . To improve with use, they learn from experience: when the outcome of a decision is known, the agent writes an experience, such as a short lesson, into its memory, and at later dates it retrieves the most relevant experiences and conditions its decision on them ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) . Which experiences it comes to rely on is decided by outcome credit , in one of two ways: an experience used in a decision that turned out well gains importance or value ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , or lessons are distilled from episodes judged by their outcomes to be successes or failures ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体正越来越多地用于管理投资组合（Yu 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2024；Li 等人，2025）。 为了在使用过程中不断改进，它们会从经验中学习：当某个决策的结果已知时，该智能体便会将一段经验（例如简短的教训）写入其记忆；在后续阶段，它会检索最相关的经验，并据此调整其决策（Shinn 等人，2023；Zhao 等人，2024）。 它最终依赖哪些经验，则由结果归因决定，具体有两种方式：一种是在成功决策中被使用的经验会获得更高的重要性或价值（Yu 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2026）；另一种则是从那些经结果判定为成功或失败的片段中提炼出教训（Shinn 等人，2023；Zhao 等人，2024）。

paragraphs.en: In portfolio management, this rule has a blind spot. The outcome of a decision is dominated by the market move over the holding period, and every decision made on that date shares this move. An experience retrieved before a rally is credited with the rally, and one retrieved before a sell-off is blamed for it, much as a treatment effect estimated without a control group mixes the treatment with everything else that happened (Figure 1 a). Table 1 measures this on three real benchmarks (§ 4.1 ), using the utility of the equal-weight (1/ N N ) portfolio over the same holding period as a proxy for the market. On every date, we generate a draft with each subset of the four retrieved experiences and compare two measures for each experience: its outcome credit, the mean utility of the drafts that used it, and its counterfactual contribution, the mean utility of these drafts minus that of the drafts without it. Outcome credit rises and falls with the market almost in lockstep, but is nearly unrelated to the contribution of the experience, which itself is unrelated to the market. As each experience is in half of the drafts, its outcome credit is the date’s mean utility plus half its contribution, and the first term dominates. Agents that accumulate outcome credit therefore rank experiences by the markets in which they were retrieved. Accordingly, every experience-learning agent we test underperforms 1/ N N on PortBench and InvestorBench (Table 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在投资组合管理中，这条规则存在一个盲点。 一项决策的结果主要由持有期内市场的变动决定，而该日期做出的每一项决策都共享这一市场变动。 在上涨行情前获得的经验会被归因于这次上涨，而在下跌行情前获得的经验则会被归咎于这次下跌；这就像在没有对照组的情况下估计治疗效应时，会将治疗效果与同期发生的一切其他因素混为一谈（图 1a）。 表 1 通过三个真实基准（§4.1）对这一现象进行了衡量，并使用相同持有期内等权重（1/N N）投资组合的效用作为市场的代理指标。 在每个日期，我们都会基于从四种经验中选取的每个子集生成一个草案，并对每种经验比较两个指标：其结果贡献度（即使用该经验的草案的平均效用），以及其反事实贡献度（即这些草案的平均效用减去未使用该经验的草案的平均效用）。 结果贡献度几乎与市场同步升降，但与经验本身的贡献度几乎没有关联，而后者本身也与市场无关。 由于每种经验都出现在半数草案中，其结果贡献度等于该日期的平均效用加上其贡献度的一半，其中前者占主导地位。 因此，积累结果贡献度的智能体会根据经验被获取时的市场表现对经验进行排序。 因此，我们在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上测试的每种经验学习智能体的表现都低于 1/N N（表 3）。

paragraphs.en: Data valuation offers a remedy: it values a data point by its marginal contribution to a utility, averaged over subsets of the other points ( Ghorbani and Zou, 2019 ; Wang and Jia, 2023 ) . Applying it to LLM portfolio agents raises two challenges (CHs).
paragraphs.zh: 数据估值提供了一种解决方案：它通过一个数据点对其效用的边际贡献来评估其价值，并对其他数据点的子集进行平均（Ghorbani and Zou, 2019；Wang and Jia, 2023）。 将其应用于 LLM 组合智能体时会带来两个挑战（CHs）。

sents.en: Data valuation offers a remedy: it values a data point by its marginal contribution to a utility, averaged over subsets of the other points ( Ghorbani and Zou, 2019 ; Wang and Jia, 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 数据估值提供了一种解决方案：它通过一个数据点对其效用的边际贡献来评估其价值，并对其他数据点的子集进行平均（Ghorbani and Zou, 2019；Wang and Jia, 2023）。

sents.en: Applying it to LLM portfolio agents raises two challenges (CHs).
sents.zh: 将其应用于 LLM 组合智能体时会带来两个挑战（CHs）。

paragraphs.en: CH1: How can an agent measure what an experience changes when every measurement is a costly, noisy LLM call on a market date that never comes back? Data valuation evaluates a utility many times on a fixed dataset. For an LLM agent, every evaluation is a paid call whose output varies from sample to sample, and every decision date is a single market episode. A contribution measured on one date is therefore mostly noise: on PortBench, the retrieved experiences change the agent’s utility detectably on only 2–4 of 56 months, about as often as chance alone would produce (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: CH1：当每一次测量都是一次代价高昂且充满噪声的 LLM 调用，而市场数据又永远无法返回时，智能体如何衡量一次经历所带来的变化？ 数据估值会在一个固定的数据集上多次评估效用。 对于 LLM 智能体而言，每一次评估都是一次付费调用，其输出因样本而异，而每一个决策日期都仅对应单一的市场事件。 因此，在某个特定日期测量的贡献值大多只是噪声：在 PortBench 中，检索到的经历仅在 56 个月中的 2 至 4 个月里对智能体的效用产生了可检测的影响，这一频率与纯粹偶然产生的结果大致相当（表 1）。

sents.en: CH1: How can an agent measure what an experience changes when every measurement is a costly, noisy LLM call on a market date that never comes back?
sents.zh: CH1：当每一次测量都是一次代价高昂且充满噪声的 LLM 调用，而市场数据又永远无法返回时，智能体如何衡量一次经历所带来的变化？

sents.en: Data valuation evaluates a utility many times on a fixed dataset.
sents.zh: 数据估值会在一个固定的数据集上多次评估效用。

sents.en: For an LLM agent, every evaluation is a paid call whose output varies from sample to sample, and every decision date is a single market episode.
sents.zh: 对于 LLM 智能体而言，每一次评估都是一次付费调用，其输出因样本而异，而每一个决策日期都仅对应单一的市场事件。

sents.zh: 因此，在某个特定日期测量的贡献值大多只是噪声：在 PortBench 中，检索到的经历仅在 56 个月中的 2 至 4 个月里对智能体的效用产生了可检测的影响，这一频率与纯粹偶然产生的结果大致相当（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: CH2: How can an agent tell whether a learned value will hold on dates it has not seen? Even where experiences clearly change the decision, as on about 85% of InvestorBench days, the contributions learned from past days do not predict those of the following days (§ 4.2 ), and selecting experiences by their average past contribution still trails 1/ N N (Table 3 ). Existing agents always act on their learned scores: they have no notion of insufficient evidence and no fallback for when their scores do not hold.
paragraphs.zh: CH2：智能体如何判断一个已学习的价值在未曾见过的日期上是否仍然有效？ 即使在经验明显改变决策的情况下（例如 InvestorBench 约 85% 的日期），从过去日期中学到的贡献度也无法预测后续日期的贡献度（§ 4.2），而根据经验的平均历史贡献度来选择经验，其表现仍然落后于 1/N N（表 3）。 现有的智能体总是依据已学习的分数采取行动：它们既没有“证据不足”的概念，也没有在分数不再有效时的备用方案。

sents.en: CH2: How can an agent tell whether a learned value will hold on dates it has not seen?
sents.zh: CH2：智能体如何判断一个已学习的价值在未曾见过的日期上是否仍然有效？

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we present MemTrial (memory on trial), an experience-learning agent that learns when to trust its memory through a closed loop of four steps (Figures 1 b and 2 ). (1) Counterfactual attribution : on every date, the agent generates eight drafts of its decision with combinations of its four retrieved experiences chosen by a fractional factorial design ( Box et al., 2005 ) , and estimates the contribution of each experience as its Banzhaf value ( Banzhaf III, 1964 ; Wang and Jia, 2023 ) , the average difference between the drafts with and without it. Because all drafts face the same market, the outcome they share cancels. (2) Value estimation : as in small-area estimation ( Fay III and Herriot, 1979 ) , a hierarchical Bayesian model pools these noisy contributions into values across dates and across experiences with similar content. (3) Trust test : following prequential analysis ( Dawid, 1984 ) , the agent scores its predicted values against the contributions measured once the outcome is known, and trusts its values only when these out-of-sample forward scores are significantly positive. (4) Anchored action : if the values are trusted, the agent deploys the draft with the highest predicted value; otherwise it deploys a blend of its drafts anchored at a conservative reference, such as 1/ N N , and learns online how far to move from it. Steps (1)–(2) address CH1, and steps (3)–(4) address CH2.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 MemTrial（记忆在试验中），这是一种经验学习智能体，它通过一个包含四个步骤的闭环（图 1b 和图 2）来学习何时信任其记忆。 （1）反事实归因：在每个日期，该智能体都会生成八个决策草案，这些草案基于通过分数因子设计（Box 等，2005）选出的四个检索经验的不同组合，并估算每种经验的贡献度，即其班扎夫值（Banzhaf III，1964；Wang 和 Jia，2023），也就是包含该经验与不包含该经验的草案之间的平均差异。 由于所有草案都面临同一市场，它们共有的结果会被抵消。 （2）价值估计：与小区域估计（Fay III 和 Herriot，1979）类似，一种分层贝叶斯模型将这些带有噪声的贡献度整合为跨日期和跨内容相似经验的价值。 （3）信任测试：遵循预序分析（Dawid，1984），该智能体将预测值与结果已知后测得的贡献度进行对比评分，并且仅当这些样本外前向得分显著为正时，才会信任其价值。 （4）锚定行动：如果价值可信，该智能体将采用预测值最高的草案；否则，它将采用以保守参考值（如 1/N N）为锚点的草案混合方案，并在线学习应偏离该参考值的程度。 步骤（1）–（2）解决 CH1，而步骤（3）–（4）解决 CH2。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate MemTrial on three real benchmarks, PortBench, InvestorBench and ClassAlloc, and on PlantedMem, a semi-synthetic environment with real prices and real LLM drafts in which the quality of every experience is known. Our contributions are: (i) we show that outcome credit, the credit rule of existing experience-learning agents, tracks the market rather than what an experience changes; (ii) we propose MemTrial, a closed learning loop that learns what each experience is worth and when this knowledge can be trusted; (iii) against 14 baselines on four benchmarks and with eight LLMs, MemTrial is the best method when experiences matter and stays close to 1/ N N when its values do not hold, where existing experience-learning agents fall behind. Appendices A – H follow the references.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个真实基准数据集（PortBench、InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc）以及一个半合成环境 PlantedMem 上对 MemTrial 进行了评估。PlantedMem 包含真实价格和真实的 LLM 草稿，其中每一次体验的质量都是已知的。 我们的贡献包括：(i) 我们证明了结果信用——现有体验学习智能体的信用规则——追踪的是市场本身，而非体验所带来的变化；(ii) 我们提出了 MemTrial，一个闭环学习机制，能够学习每次体验的价值以及何时可以信任这种知识；(iii) 在四个基准数据集上，与 14 种基线方法结合使用八种 LLM 进行对比时，当体验具有重要性时，MemTrial 表现最佳；而当体验价值不成立时，其结果则接近 1/N，而现有体验学习智能体则表现不佳。 附录 A–H 列出了相关参考文献。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents for financial decision making. LLM agents now trade single assets and allocate across many. FinMem ( Yu et al., 2025 ) ranks memories by recency, relevance and an importance that trading feedback reinforces; FinCon ( Yu et al., 2024 ) updates the investment beliefs of a team of agents by verbal reinforcement from realized profit and loss; FinAgent ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) and CryptoTrade ( Li et al., 2024 ) reflect on past trades; and TradingAgents ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) simulates the roles of a trading firm. InvestorBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) and PortBench ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) evaluate such agents on stocks, cryptocurrencies and multi-asset portfolios. These agents judge a memory, reflection or strategy by the outcome of the trades that used it, which the market move dominates, and none of them checks whether what it has learned holds on later dates.
paragraphs.zh: 用于金融决策的 LLM 智能体。 LLM 智能体现在可以交易单一资产，并在多种资产中进行配置。 FinMem（Yu 等，2025）根据记忆的近期性、相关性和由交易反馈强化的重要性对记忆进行排序；FinCon（Yu 等，2024）通过已实现盈亏的口头强化来更新智能体团队的投资信念；FinAgent（Zhang 等，2024）和 CryptoTrade（Li 等，2024）会对过往交易进行反思；而 TradingAgents（Xiao 等，2024）则模拟了交易公司的角色。 InvestorBench（Li 等，2025）和 PortBench（Zhao 等，2026）在股票、加密货币和多资产组合方面对这类智能体进行评估。 这些智能体根据使用某项记忆、反思或策略的交易结果来评判其效果，而市场走势在其中起主导作用；但它们都没有验证自己所学到的内容是否在后续日期仍然有效。

paragraphs.en: Experience learning and memory in LLM agents. Outside finance, Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) turns feedback on failed attempts into verbal reflections, ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) distils insights from successful and failed trajectories, Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) keeps a library of skills that it reuses when they succeed, and Generative Agents ( Park et al., 2023 ) , MemoryBank ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) and MemGPT ( Packer et al., 2023 ) decide which memories to retrieve, keep or forget by recency, importance and relevance. MemRL ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) learns a value for each memory from the rewards of the episodes that used it, and retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) retrieves by similarity alone. These methods credit outcomes to the memories involved or distil lessons from successes and failures, and never test whether what they learn holds later. This works when outcomes reflect the agent’s own choices, as in games, coding or multi-agent environments, but not when a shock shared by all decisions dominates them.
paragraphs.zh: 体验大型语言模型智能体中的学习与记忆。 在金融领域之外，Reflexion（Shinn 等，2023）将失败尝试的反馈转化为言语反思，ExpeL（Zhao 等，2024）从成功和失败的轨迹中提炼洞见，Voyager（Wang 等，2023）维护一个技能库，并在这些技能成功时重复使用它们，而 Generative Agents（Park 等，2023）、MemoryBank（Zhong 等，2024）和 MemGPT（Packer 等，2023）则根据记忆的新近性、重要性和相关性来决定哪些记忆需要检索、保留或遗忘。 MemRL（Zhang 等，2026）从使用某段记忆的回合奖励中为其学习一个价值，而检索增强生成（Lewis 等，2020）则仅通过相似性进行检索。 这些方法将结果归因于相关的记忆，或从成功与失败中提炼经验，但从未检验它们所学到的内容是否在后来的情境中依然成立。 当结果反映智能体自身的选择时（例如在游戏、编程或多智能体环境中），这种方法有效；但当所有决策都受到一个共同冲击的主导时，这种方法则不适用。

paragraphs.en: Counterfactual credit and data valuation. Data Shapley ( Ghorbani and Zou, 2019 ; Jia et al., 2019 ) , Beta Shapley ( Kwon and Zou, 2021 ) and Data Banzhaf ( Wang and Jia, 2023 ) value a training point by its averaged marginal contributions to a model’s performance, and Data Banzhaf is the most robust of them when the utility is noisy. Influence functions ( Koh and Liang, 2017 ) approximate the effect of removing a point. Uplift modelling ( Gutierrez and Gérardy, 2017 ) and counterfactual learning from logged decisions ( Bottou et al., 2013 ; Swaminathan and Joachims, 2015 ) estimate the effect of an action from observational data. These methods value data for a fixed model and test set, or estimate effects from logs in which, in our setting, the market and the choice of memory are confounded. None of them measures what a memory changes in an LLM’s decisions, or asks whether values learned on past dates predict future ones.
paragraphs.zh: 反事实信用与数据估值。 Data Shapley（Ghorbani 和 Zou，2019；Jia 等，2019）、Beta Shapley（Kwon 和 Zou，2021）以及 Data Banzhaf（Wang 和 Jia，2023）通过训练点对模型性能的平均边际贡献来评估其价值，当效用存在噪声时，Data Banzhaf 是其中最稳健的方法。 影响函数（Koh 和 Liang，2017）可近似估算移除某个数据点所产生的影响。 Uplift 建模（Gutierrez 和 Gérardy，2017）以及基于日志决策的反事实学习（Bottou 等，2013；Swaminathan 和 Joachims，2015）能够从观测数据中估算某项行动的影响。 这些方法针对固定的模型和测试集来评估数据价值，或从日志中估算影响，但在我们的设定中，市场与记忆的选择存在混淆。 这些方法均未衡量记忆在大型语言模型决策中的具体变化，也未探究过去日期学到的价值观能否预测未来的价值观。

paragraphs.en: Safe deployment and portfolio choice under estimation error. Safe policy improvement deploys a learned policy only when it beats a baseline with high confidence ( Thomas et al., 2015 ; Laroche et al., 2019 ) , and prequential analysis ( Dawid, 1984 ) judges a model by its sequential out-of-sample predictions. In portfolio choice, estimation error makes optimized portfolios hard to trust: none of those evaluated by DeMiguel et al. (2009) consistently beats 1/ N N out of sample, which motivates shrinkage towards conservative targets ( Jorion, 1986 ; Ledoit and Wolf, 2003 ; Tu and Zhou, 2011 ) . MemTrial brings these ideas to the memory of LLM agents: a trust test on forward scores decides whether its learned values are trusted, and until then an anchored blend learns online how far to move from a conservative reference.
paragraphs.zh: 在估计误差下的安全部署与投资组合选择。 安全策略改进仅在所学策略以高置信度优于基线时才会部署（Thomas 等，2015；Laroche 等，2019），而预序分析（Dawid，1984）则通过模型在序列外样本上的预测来评估其性能。 在投资组合选择中，估计误差使得优化后的投资组合难以令人信服：DeMiguel 等（2009）所评估的这些策略中，没有任何一种能在外样本上稳定地优于 1/N 策略。 这一现象促使人们将投资组合向保守目标进行收缩（Jorion，1986；Ledoit 和 Wolf，2003；Tu 和 Zhou，2011）。 MemTrial 将这些理念引入 LLM 智能体的记忆机制中：通过对其前向得分进行可信度测试来决定是否信任所学到的值；在此之前，一个锚定混合模型会在线学习如何从保守参考策略出发调整策略的偏离程度。

sents.en: (2009) consistently beats 1/ N N out of sample, which motivates shrinkage towards conservative targets ( Jorion, 1986 ; Ledoit and Wolf, 2003 ; Tu and Zhou, 2011 ) .
sents.zh: 这一现象促使人们将投资组合向保守目标进行收缩（Jorion，1986；Ledoit 和 Wolf，2003；Tu 和 Zhou，2011）。

sents.en: MemTrial brings these ideas to the memory of LLM agents: a trust test on forward scores decides whether its learned values are trusted, and until then an anchored blend learns online how far to move from a conservative reference.
sents.zh: MemTrial 将这些理念引入 LLM 智能体的记忆机制中：通过对其前向得分进行可信度测试来决定是否信任所学到的值；在此之前，一个锚定混合模型会在线学习如何从保守参考策略出发调整策略的偏离程度。

paragraphs.en: What is new in MemTrial is not the Banzhaf value ( Banzhaf III, 1964 ) but how it is measured and used: on LLM decisions through a designed experiment on each date, pooled into a value model, and trusted only after this model has predicted unseen dates. Please refer to Appendix A for more related work.
paragraphs.zh: MemTrial 的新意并不在于 Banzhaf 值（Banzhaf III，1964），而在于其测量与使用方式：通过在每个日期上开展设计好的实验来评估大型语言模型（LLM）的决策，将这些结果汇总成一个价值模型，并且只有在该模型成功预测了未见的日期之后，才会对其产生信任。 更多相关研究请参见附录 A。

At each decision date t = 1 , … , T t=1,\dots,T , it observes the market state s t s_{t} and outputs portfolio weights x t x_{t} , which are held over a holding period. A projection P θ P_{\theta} enforces the investor’s mandate, a cap M M on the share of risky assets and a floor m m on the share of defensive assets; the investor profile θ = ( M , m , γ ) \theta=(M,m,\gamma) also contains the risk aversion γ \gamma . A decision is scored by the investor utility of the executed portfolio, a certainty-equivalent (CEQ) return ( DeMiguel et al., 2009 ) ,

paragraphs.en: An LLM agent with an experience memory. The agent is an LLM policy π \pi that maps the state and a set of experiences S S to weights, x ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ s t , S ) x\sim\pi(\cdot\mid s_{t},S) . Its memory holds experiences written once the outcomes of earlier decisions were known: lessons, or records of earlier decisions and their outcomes. At date t t , the retriever returns the k = 4 k=4 experiences whose embeddings are most similar to that of the current state, R t = ( h t , 1 , … , h t , k ) R_{t}=(h_{t,1},\dots,h_{t,k}) . Because the LLM samples at a positive temperature, the same prompt yields different weights; we call each sample a draft . Experience learning selects which retrieved experiences enter the prompt, S t ⊆ R t S_{t}\subseteq R_{t} , based on scores learned from earlier dates. Existing agents credit an experience used at date t t with u t ​ ( x t ) u_{t}(x_{t}) , the utility of the whole decision ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , which Table 1 shows mostly measures the market.

paragraphs.en: Our goal and the MemTrial loop. We aim to maximize the investor’s cumulative utility ∑ t u t ​ ( x t ) \sum_{t}u_{t}(x_{t}) by learning what each experience is worth, from what it changes in decisions, and when this knowledge can be trusted. Figure 2 shows the loop (Algorithm F.1 in Appendix F gives its pseudocode). Before the outcome of date t t is known, MemTrial generates drafts with designed subsets of R t R_{t} and acts (§ 3.5 ) according to the trust test (§ 3.4 ). After the outcome is known, it attributes the change in utility to each experience (§ 3.2 ), updates the values (§ 3.3 ) and scores their predictions (§ 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标与 MemTrial 循环。 我们的目标是最大化投资者的累积效用 ∑ t u t ​ ( x t ) \sum_{t}u_{t}(x_{t})，方法是学习每次体验的价值——即它如何改变决策，以及何时可以信任这种认知。 图 2 展示了该循环（附录 F 中的算法 F.1 给出了其伪代码）。 在日期 t t 的结果已知之前，MemTrial 会生成包含 R t R_{t} 中指定子集的草案，并根据信任测试（§ 3.4）采取行动（§ 3.5）。 结果已知后，它会将效用的变化归因于每次体验（§ 3.2），更新各值的数值（§ 3.3），并评估其预测的得分（§ 3.4）。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical value model. A contribution measured on a single date is mostly noise, and a new experience has no measurements at all. paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. Table 2 summarizes the four benchmarks, and Appendix D.1 gives their construction. On PortBench ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , each decision starts from the equal-weight portfolio, holds for 20 trading days and pays 15 bp on the amount traded. PortBench’s native prompt shows prices for only eight of its 99 assets: PortBench-Raw keeps this prompt, and PortBench-Full shows every eligible asset; the prompts of the other benchmarks show every asset. On InvestorBench ( Li et al., 2025 ) , the agent also reads daily news and writes its lessons during a warm-up from July to September 2020. ClassAlloc tests agents after the LLM’s knowledge cutoff: built from PortBench’s prices, it ends 21 months after that of gpt-4.1-mini ( OpenAI, 2025a ) (June 2024), carries holdings from month to month, and gives every learner an outcome only after its 20 trading days. Experiences are retrieved by embedding similarity, with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) on PortBench and text-embedding-3-small ( OpenAI, 2024 ) on InvestorBench and ClassAlloc. PlantedMem keeps real prices and real LLM drafts but plants twelve experiences of known quality: three useful, six neutral and three misleading. A useful (misleading) experience moves a share β \beta of the draft to an asset class, with probability 0.7 the one that does best (worst) next (Appendix D.3 ). Retrieval depends on the market regime, which reproduces the market confound. Five core regimes vary how strongly experiences move a draft (no influence, noise only, and β ∈ { 0.1 , 0.25 , 0.5 } \beta\in\{0.1,0.25,0.5\} ), and two more have 48 experiences whose content is uninformative ( many experiences ) or informative ( informative content ) about their quality.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试。 表2总结了四个基准测试，附录D.1介绍了它们的构建方法。 在PortBench（Zhao等，2026）中，每个决策都从等权重投资组合开始，持续20个交易日，并对交易金额收取15个基点的费用。 PortBench的原生提示词仅显示其99个资产中的8个的价格：PortBench-Raw保留此提示词，而PortBench-Full则显示所有符合条件的资产；其他基准测试的提示词均显示全部资产。 在InvestorBench（Li等，2025）中，智能体还会阅读每日新闻，并在2020年7月至9月的预热阶段撰写其经验总结。 ClassAlloc在LLM的知识截止日期之后对智能体进行测试：该测试基于PortBench的价格构建，在gpt-4.1-mini（OpenAI，2025a）的截止日期（2024年6月）之后21个月结束，持仓按月延续，并且只有在完成20个交易日后才向每个学习者提供结果。 经验通过嵌入相似度进行检索：PortBench使用Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B（Zhang等，2025），而InvestorBench和ClassAlloc则使用text-embedding-3-small（OpenAI，2024）。 PlantedMem保留真实价格和真实的LLM草稿，但会植入十二个已知质量的经验：三个有用、六个中性、三个具有误导性。 一个有用（具有误导性）的经验会将草稿中β比例的份额转移到一个资产类别，其中概率为0.7时转移至下一期表现最好（最差）的类别（附录D.3）。 检索依赖于市场状态，该状态会重现市场混淆效应。 五种核心状态通过改变经验对草稿的影响强度而有所不同（无影响、仅噪声以及β∈{0.1,0.25,0.5}），另外两种状态则包含48个关于其质量无信息量（大量经验）或有信息量（信息丰富的内容）的经验。

paragraphs.en: Baselines (Appendix D.2 ). (i) Rule-based: 1/ N N projected to the mandate ( DeMiguel et al., 2009 ) and Minimum variance ( Markowitz, 1955 ) . (ii) LLM agents without experience learning: Memory-free (zero-shot) ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , Self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2022 ) (the average of three memory-free drafts) and Similarity retrieval ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) of the two or four most similar experiences. (iii) Experience-learning agents: FinMem ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , MemRL ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) and ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . (iv) Credit-based and ensemble learners: Uplift credit ( Gutierrez and Gérardy, 2017 ) , which regresses outcomes on experience usage with a market control; Counterfactual selection, which selects experiences by our contributions ( 3 ) without value estimation or trust test; Draft averaging ( Bates and Granger, 1969 ) , which deploys the average of MemTrial’s eight drafts; and Hedge ( Freund and Schapire, 1997 ) over 1/ N N and the memory configurations. Where a baseline’s own module cannot run, we re-implement its memory-scoring rule (marked †); on PortBench, ExpeL† votes over the experiences, and the FinMem and MemRL modules receive no feedback after July 2019 (Appendix D.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法（附录 D.2）。 （i）基于规则的方法：1/N N 投影到指令（DeMiguel 等，2009）以及最小方差法（Markowitz，1955）。 （ii）无经验学习的 LLM 智能体：无记忆方法（零样本）（Brown 等，2020）、自洽性方法（Wang 等，2022）（三种无记忆草案的平均值），以及对最相似的两到四个经验的相似性检索（Lewis 等，2020）。 （iii）经验学习智能体：FinMem（Yu 等，2025）、MemRL（Zhang 等，2026）、Reflexion（Shinn 等，2023）以及 ExpeL（Zhao 等，2024）。 （iv）基于信用和集成学习的方法：提升信用法（Gutierrez 和 Gérardy，2017），该方法通过市场控制对经验使用情况进行回归分析；反事实选择法，该方法根据我们的贡献（3）选择经验，无需价值估计或信任测试；草案平均法（Bates 和 Granger，1969），该方法采用 MemTrial 八个草案的平均值；以及对 1/N N 和记忆配置应用 Hedge 方法（Freund 和 Schapire，1997）。 当某个基线方法的自身模块无法运行时，我们会重新实现其记忆评分规则（标记为 †）；在 PortBench 上，ExpeL† 会对经验进行投票，而 FinMem 和 MemRL 模块在 2019 年 7 月之后不会收到任何反馈（附录 D.2）。

paragraphs.en: Implementation and statistics. All LLM agents use gpt-4.1-mini (2025-04-14) at temperature 0.7, which gives the distinct drafts that MemTrial, Self-consistency and Draft averaging need. MemTrial uses k = 4 k=4 , the design ( 2 ), d = 8 d=8 , α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 with at least 10 forward scores, α 0 = 0.9 \alpha_{0}=0.9 and λ 0 = 4 \lambda_{0}=4 . Its reference is 1/ N N on the real benchmarks and the average of eight memory-free drafts in PlantedMem, where 1/ N N ignores the risk aversion. It was frozen before any InvestorBench decision, so InvestorBench, ClassAlloc and the runs with other LLMs are held-out tests. On the real benchmarks, each of three seeds is an independent deployment in which every draft is sampled anew; PlantedMem uses 100 test seeds, each a new world. Tables report the mean ± \pm sd over seeds, with the best result in bold and the second best underlined . Improv. is the gain of MemTrial over the best experience-learning agent of each setting, in percent of that agent’s utility, and * marks a significant improvement ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 , one-sided paired t t -test over test dates, or over seeds in PlantedMem). The trust rate is the share of decisions on which MemTrial acts on its learned values. Appendix D.3 gives further implementation details and Appendix G the prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 实现与统计。 所有 LLM 智能体均使用 gpt-4.1-mini (2025-04-14)，温度设为 0.7，从而生成 MemTrial、Self-consistency 和 Draft averaging 所需的独立草案。 MemTrial 使用 k = 4、设计参数 (2)、d = 8、α = 0.05，且至少需要 10 个前向得分；此外 α₀ = 0.9 和 λ₀ = 4。 在真实基准测试中，其参考值为 1/N；而在 PlantedMem 中，则为八份无记忆草案的平均值，其中 1/N 忽略了风险规避因素。 该模型在做出任何 InvestorBench 决策前已被冻结，因此 InvestorBench、ClassAlloc 以及使用其他 LLM 的运行均作为保留测试集。 在真实基准测试中，三个种子中的每个种子都代表一次独立部署，其中每份草案都会被重新采样；PlantedMem 使用 100 个测试种子，每个种子对应一个全新的世界。 表格报告了各种子上的均值 ± 标准差（sd），最佳结果以粗体显示，次优结果以下划线标出。 Improv. 表示 MemTrial 相较于每种设置中表现最佳的体验学习智能体的提升幅度，以该智能体效用的百分比计算；* 标记显著改进（p < 0.05，通过单侧配对 t 检验在测试日期或 PlantedMem 的种子间验证）。 信任率是指 MemTrial 依据其学习到的价值观做出决策的占比。 附录 D.3 提供了更多实现细节，附录 G 列出了提示词。

paragraphs.en: Overall performance. Table 3 (PlantedMem: mean of the five core regimes) shows that MemTrial is the best of all 15 methods in PlantedMem and the best LLM-based method on PortBench and InvestorBench. Averaged over the five settings, its utility is 21.2% higher than that of the best experience-learning agent. In PlantedMem, where experiences carry real signal, the gain is 0.10 pp per month. On PortBench and InvestorBench, no LLM-based method beats 1/ N N : the LLM’s drafts fail to outperform equal weighting, and their frequent reallocation costs fees and adds risk (Appendix D.4 ). MemTrial is the only LLM-based method that stays close to 1/ N N there, at most 2.2% below it, whereas the best existing experience-learning agent falls 15–38% behind. On PortBench-Full, the lead of 1/ N N and MemTrial depends on the last test month (November 2024), in which cryptocurrencies rose by 129%: without it, Similarity retrieval (top-4) and Hedge come out slightly ahead of both (Appendix D.6 ). On ClassAlloc, the memory-free LLM beats 1/ N N , but no form of memory improves on it (Appendix D.11 ); § 4.5 shows that this advantage lies in the months before the LLM’s knowledge cutoff (June 2024).
paragraphs.zh: 整体表现。 表3（PlantedMem：五种核心机制的平均值）显示，在 PlantedMem 中，MemTrial 是全部15种方法中的最佳方法；在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上，它也是基于LLM的最佳方法。 在五种设置中取平均值后，其效用比最佳经验学习智能体高出21.2%。 在 PlantedMem 中，由于经验携带真实信号，每月收益为0.10个百分点。 在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上，没有任何基于LLM的方法能优于 1/N N：LLM的草案未能超越等权重策略，且频繁重新分配不仅产生费用，还增加了风险（附录D.4）。 MemTrial 是唯一能在此处接近 1/N N 的基于LLM的方法，最多仅比其低2.2%；而现有的最佳经验学习智能体则落后15%至38%。 在 PortBench-Full 上，1/N N 和 MemTrial 的优势取决于最后一个测试月份（2024年11月），该月加密货币价格上涨了129%；若没有这一因素，Similarity retrieval（前4名）和 Hedge 会略优于两者（附录D.6）。 在 ClassAlloc 上，无需记忆的LLM优于 1/N N，但任何形式的记忆都无法进一步改善其表现（附录D.11）；§4.5表明，这一优势体现在LLM知识截止日（2024年6月）之前的月份中。

sents.zh: 在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上，没有任何基于LLM的方法能优于 1/N N：LLM的草案未能超越等权重策略，且频繁重新分配不仅产生费用，还增加了风险（附录D.4）。

sents.en: MemTrial is the only LLM-based method that stays close to 1/ N N there, at most 2.2% below it, whereas the best existing experience-learning agent falls 15–38% behind.
sents.zh: MemTrial 是唯一能在此处接近 1/N N 的基于LLM的方法，最多仅比其低2.2%；而现有的最佳经验学习智能体则落后15%至38%。

sents.en: On PortBench-Full, the lead of 1/ N N and MemTrial depends on the last test month (November 2024), in which cryptocurrencies rose by 129%: without it, Similarity retrieval (top-4) and Hedge come out slightly ahead of both (Appendix D.6 ).
sents.zh: 在 PortBench-Full 上，1/N N 和 MemTrial 的优势取决于最后一个测试月份（2024年11月），该月加密货币价格上涨了129%；若没有这一因素，Similarity retrieval（前4名）和 Hedge 会略优于两者（附录D.6）。

sents.en: On ClassAlloc, the memory-free LLM beats 1/ N N , but no form of memory improves on it (Appendix D.11 ); § 4.5 shows that this advantage lies in the months before the LLM’s knowledge cutoff (June 2024).
sents.zh: 在 ClassAlloc 上，无需记忆的LLM优于 1/N N，但任何形式的记忆都无法进一步改善其表现（附录D.11）；§4.5表明，这一优势体现在LLM知识截止日（2024年6月）之前的月份中。

paragraphs.en: Wealth over time. Figure 3 follows the wealth of the three investors on PortBench-Full, InvestorBench and ClassAlloc (red shading marks falling markets and the dotted line the knowledge cutoff); on PortBench, whose decisions each start from the equal-weight portfolio, wealth compounds their net returns. For every investor, MemTrial tracks 1/ N N through rising and falling markets, while the other LLM-based methods drift away from it, mostly below. In Table 4 , MemTrial has the best Sharpe ratio and drawdown of the LLM-based methods on every benchmark, and the highest return on PortBench and InvestorBench, where no LLM-based method has a higher return than 1/ N N . Across all 162 runs (both PortBench variants and eight LLMs on InvestorBench and ClassAlloc, each with three investors and three seeds), the wealth of MemTrial never fell more than 5% behind that of 1/ N N , whereas the memory-free LLM and the experience-learning agents did so in 22–44% of their runs (Appendix D.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 财富随时间的变化。 图3展示了 PortBench-Full、InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc 中三位投资者的财富变化（红色阴影区域表示市场下跌，虚线表示知识截止点）；在 PortBench 中，每位投资者的决策均从等权投资组合开始，财富则通过其净回报进行复利计算。 对于每一位投资者，MemTrial 都会在市场涨跌过程中持续跟踪 1/N N，而其他基于 LLM 的方法则会逐渐偏离这一策略，且大多位于其下方。 在表4中，MemTrial 在所有基准测试中均表现出优于其他基于 LLM 的方法的夏普比率和最大回撤，并且在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上实现了最高的回报；在这些测试中，没有任何一种基于 LLM 的方法的回报高于 1/N N。 在所有162次运行中（包括两种 PortBench 变体以及 InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc 上的八种 LLM，每种均包含三位投资者和三个种子），MemTrial 的财富从未落后于 1/N N 超过5%，而无需记忆的 LLM 和经验学习智能体则在22%至44%的运行中出现了这种情况（附录 D.6）。

paragraphs.en: Why does MemTrial help? Three components account for this. First, counterfactual attribution removes the market from the contribution. In PlantedMem, counterfactual selection beats selection by outcome credit (MemRL†), whereas adjusting outcome credit for the market by regression (Uplift credit) closes only a third of this gap. Second, the trust test keeps MemTrial from acting on values that do not carry over to unseen dates. On PortBench and InvestorBench, the values learned from past dates did not predict the following dates, so the test almost never passed (on at most 0.6% of decisions, Table 3 ). Counterfactual selection, which acts on past contributions without such a test, trails 1/ N N as much as the other agents. Third, the anchor protects MemTrial on these benchmarks. The drafts alone do not: Draft averaging deploys the same eight drafts and falls well behind 1/ N N . With the same anchor, however, every LLM-based baseline also comes within 1% of MemTrial. With signal in PlantedMem, MemTrial earns 11% more than the best anchored baseline, as it acts fully on values that have predicted unseen dates (Appendix D.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: MemTrial 为何有效？ 这归因于三个组成部分。 首先，反事实归因将市场从贡献度计算中排除。 在 PlantedMem 中，反事实选择优于基于结果信用的选择（MemRL†），而通过回归调整市场的结果信用（Uplift credit）仅能缩小这一差距的三分之一。 其次，信任测试防止 MemTrial 基于无法预测未来日期的价值观采取行动。 在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上，从过去日期学到的价值观无法预测后续日期，因此该测试几乎从未通过（最多仅 0.6% 的决策通过，见表 3）。 反事实选择无需此类测试即可基于过往贡献度采取行动，其表现与 1/ N N 相比落后于其他智能体。 第三，锚定机制在这些基准测试中保护了 MemTrial。 仅靠草案则无法做到这一点：草案平均法使用相同的八个草案，且表现远逊于 1/ N N。 然而，在采用相同锚定机制的情况下，所有基于 LLM 的基线模型也能将差距缩小至 MemTrial 的 1% 以内。 在 PlantedMem 存在信号的情况下，MemTrial 的表现比最佳锚定基线模型高出 11%，因为它能完全基于能够预测未来日期的价值观采取行动（附录 D.5）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 changes one step of MemTrial at a time; PlantedMem is split into the core regimes without signal (no influence, noise only), those with signal ( β > 0 \beta>0 ), and the regime with 48 experiences and informative content. On real markets, the anchor and the trust test matter: replacing the anchored blend by the draft average costs 16–41% on PortBench and InvestorBench, and acting on the values without the trust test 4–12%, as these values do not hold on unseen dates. The prior weight on the reference sets a trade-off: a uniform prior loses 5–7% on PortBench and InvestorBench but gains 3.2% on ClassAlloc, where the drafts beat 1/ N N , and the opposite extreme, always keeping the reference, gains where 1/ N N cannot be beaten but loses where the drafts are better (Appendix D.8 ). Learning the blend online matters less: fixing it at the prior changes the utility by − 3 -3 % to + 1 +1 %. On ClassAlloc, where the test passed most often, never acting on values is 2.6% better (Appendices D.5 and E ).
paragraphs.zh: 图4每次仅改变MemTrial的一个步骤；PlantedMem被划分为无信号的核心机制（无影响，仅有噪声）、有信号的机制（β > 0），以及包含48次体验和信息内容的机制。 在真实市场中，锚定和信任测试至关重要：用草案平均值替代锚定混合值，在PortBench和InvestorBench上的成本损失为16%–41%；若在不进行信任测试的情况下对数值采取行动，则损失为4%–12%，因为这些数值在未见日期上并不成立。 参考集的先验权重设定了一种权衡：均匀先验在PortBench和InvestorBench上会损失5%–7%，但在ClassAlloc上却能获得3.2%的增益（在该场景中，草案优于1/N），而另一个极端情况——始终保留参考值——则在1/N无法被超越时获得增益，但在草案表现更优时则会受损（附录D.8）。 在线学习混合值的重要性较低：将其固定为先验值会使效用变化在−3%至+1%之间。 在ClassAlloc中，测试最常通过，而完全不根据数值采取行动的表现则好2.6%（附录D.5和E）。

paragraphs.en: In PlantedMem, the learned values matter where experiences carry signal: never acting on them costs 15% (8.5% with informative content), and almost nothing without signal. The trust test costs little there: removing it gains 0.9–2.4% with signal but loses 2.3% without. Content-aware value estimation and the trust test matter when each experience is retrieved too rarely for per-experience estimates or for an in-sample F-test (5–6% with informative content).
paragraphs.zh: 在 PlantedMem 中，当经验携带信号时，学习到的价值观至关重要：从不依据这些价值观采取行动会损失 15%（若包含信息性内容则为 8.5%），而在没有信号的情况下则几乎没有任何损失。 信任测试在此处的成本很低：移除该测试在存在信号时能带来 0.9–2.4% 的增益，但在没有信号时会导致 2.3% 的损失。 当每次经验被检索的频率过低，无法进行逐经验估计或样本内 F 检验时，内容感知的价值观评估和信任测试就显得尤为重要（若包含信息性内容，影响幅度为 5–6%）。

paragraphs.en: We repeat InvestorBench and ClassAlloc with seven other LLMs: gpt-4.1-nano ( OpenAI, 2025a ) , gpt-5-mini ( OpenAI, 2025b ) , Gemini 2.5 Flash ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , Claude Haiku 4.5 ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , and the open-weight Llama-3.3-70B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Qwen3-235B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and DeepSeek-V3.1 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ) . We also run InvestorBench at temperatures 0, 0.3 and 1.0. Appendix D.12 gives every LLM, temperature and method. On InvestorBench, no LLM-based baseline beats 1/ N N in any of the eleven configurations, and MemTrial beats all of them in every configuration, by 4–33% over the best experience-learning agent. On ClassAlloc, MemTrial stays within 0.021 pp per month of 1/ N N with every LLM; it beats the best experience-learning agent with four of the eight LLMs and trails it with the other four. Without its trust test, MemTrial does worse in most configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们重复了 InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc 实验，并使用了另外七种大型语言模型（LLM）：gpt-4.1-nano（OpenAI，2025a）、gpt-5-mini（OpenAI，2025b）、Gemini 2.5 Flash（Comanici 等，2025）、Claude Haiku 4.5（Anthropic，2025），以及开源权重模型 Llama-3.3-70B（Grattafiori 等，2024）、Qwen3-235B（Yang 等，2025）和 DeepSeek-V3.1（DeepSeek-AI，2024）。 我们还在温度值为 0、0.3 和 1.0 的情况下运行了 InvestorBench。 附录 D.12 列出了所有 LLM、温度值和实验方法。 在 InvestorBench 中，没有任何基于 LLM 的基线模型能在十一种配置中击败 1/N N；而 MemTrial 在所有配置中都击败了这些模型，且与表现最佳的经验学习智能体相比，性能提升了 4%–33%。 在 ClassAlloc 中，MemTrial 使用每种 LLM 时，每月与 1/N N 的差距均未超过 0.021 个百分点；在使用八种 LLM 中的四种时，它击败了表现最佳的经验学习智能体，而在另外四种 LLM 中则稍逊于后者。 如果不包含信任测试，MemTrial 在大多数配置中的表现会更差。

paragraphs.en: Does MemTrial learn what each experience is worth? In PlantedMem, the quality of every experience is known, so we can check how well the learned values rank them (Figure 5 ; balanced investor). Outcome credit hardly ranks them: after ten years of monthly decisions, the correlation is 0.08 at β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 and only 0.29 even at β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 , because it follows the markets in which an experience was retrieved. Counterfactual contributions rank them well, and the pooled values of MemTrial reach the same level (0.81 at β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 ); with 48 experiences whose content is informative, pooling across similar experiences ranks them better than the raw contributions (0.66 against 0.55). Early on, the shrunk values are less accurate and MemTrial rarely acts on them; at β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 , its trust rate rises from 12% in the first year to 91% in the tenth as evidence accumulates.
paragraphs.zh: MemTrial 能否学会每次体验的价值？ 在 PlantedMem 中，每次体验的质量都是已知的，因此我们可以检验学习到的价值对其排序的准确性（图 5；平衡投资者）。 结果归因几乎无法对它们进行有效排序：经过十年每月决策后，在 β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 时相关系数仅为 0.08，即使在 β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 时也只有 0.29，因为它遵循的是体验被调用的市场走势。 反事实贡献度能很好地对它们进行排序，而 MemTrial 的合并价值也达到了相同水平（β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 时为 0.81）；对于内容具有信息量的 48 次体验，对相似体验进行合并后的排序优于原始贡献度（0.66 对比 0.55）。 在早期阶段，收缩后的价值准确性较低，MemTrial 也很少据此采取行动；在 β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 时，随着证据积累，其信任率从第一年的 12% 上升到第十年的 91%。

paragraphs.en: When does MemTrial trust its values? Figure 6 shows PlantedMem by regime. When experiences carry no signal, the trust test passes on only 2–3% of decisions and MemTrial stays at the reference, whereas Counterfactual selection and outcome credit fall below it. As experiences matter more, the test passes more often, on up to 85% of decisions, and MemTrial gains up to 0.30 pp per month over the reference. On the real benchmarks, the test responds to whether learned values carry over to unseen dates, not to whether experiences matter: on InvestorBench, experiences change the decision on 85% of days, yet the test passed on only 0.3% of decisions. Where it passed most often (15% of ClassAlloc decisions), the trusted drafts earned 0.05 0.05 pp less (s.e. 0.07 0.07 ) than the anchored blend they replaced (Appendices D.11 and E ).
paragraphs.zh: MemTrial 何时会信任其价值观？ 图 6 展示了不同机制下的 PlantedMem。 当经验不携带任何信号时，信任测试仅在 2–3% 的决策中通过，且 MemTrial 保持在参考值水平；而反事实选择与结果归因则低于该参考值。 随着经验的重要性提升，测试通过的频率也更高，最高可达 85% 的决策，且 MemTrial 每月比参考值最多高出 0.30 个百分点。 在真实基准测试中，该测试反映的是已学习的价值观能否延续到未见的日期，而非经验是否重要：在 InvestorBench 上，经验影响了 85% 日期的决策，但测试仅通过了 0.3% 的决策。 在测试通过频率最高的情况下（ClassAlloc 决策的 15%），被信任的草案所获得的收益比其取代的锚定混合方案低 0.05 至 0.05 个百分点（标准误差为 0.07 至 0.07）（见附录 D.11 和 E）。

paragraphs.en: What happens after the LLM’s knowledge cutoff? On ClassAlloc, the memory-free LLM beats 1/ N N by 0.08 pp per month before the knowledge cutoff of gpt-4.1-mini and trails it by as much afterwards ( p = 0.36 p=0.36 for the difference), and five of the six LLMs whose cutoff is published show the same pattern. Given only a date, each LLM recalls the asset-class returns of the following month before its cutoff (a look-ahead bias) but hardly at all after it; yet hiding every date from the agent does not remove the advantage before the cutoff (Appendices D.13 – D.14 , Figure D.6 ). Anchored at 1/ N N , MemTrial gives up most of the drafts’ advantage before the cutoff but loses less than any other LLM-based method after it (Appendix D.11 ). On PortBench extended to 2026, it is again the best LLM-based method over the eleven months after the cutoff of gpt-4.1-mini (Appendix D.15 ).
paragraphs.zh: LLM的知识截止之后会发生什么？ 在ClassAlloc上，无内存的LLM在gpt-4.1-mini的知识截止前每月比1/N N高出0.08个百分点，但在此之后则明显落后（差异的p值为0.36 p=0.36），而六个已公布知识截止日期的LLM中有五个都表现出相同的模式。 仅给定一个日期时，每个LLM都能在知识截止前回忆起次月的资产类别回报（一种前瞻偏差），但在截止之后几乎无法做到；然而，即使从智能体中隐藏所有日期，也无法消除其在知识截止前的优势（附录D.13 – D.14，图D.6）。 以1/N N为基准，MemTrial在知识截止前放弃了大部分草稿带来的优势，但在截止之后损失却少于任何其他基于LLM的方法（附录D.11）。 在扩展至2026年的PortBench上，它在gpt-4.1-mini知识截止后的十一个月中再次成为表现最佳的基于LLM的方法（附录D.15）。

paragraphs.en: Hyperparameters and cost. Appendix D.7 varies the level α \alpha of the trust test (Figure D.4 ). Up to the default α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 , the results on the real benchmarks barely change. Looser levels let chance forward scores pass, on up to 17% of PortBench-Full decisions, and cost up to 4% of the utility, whereas in the informative regime of PlantedMem they let MemTrial act earlier on values that do hold. The anchor needs a strong prior on the reference (§ 4.3 ) but not a precise strength, and more retrieved experiences help only when experiences matter (Appendices D.7 – D.9 ). A decision costs about USD 0.05 on PortBench; at the same LLM spend, Draft averaging does clearly worse.
paragraphs.zh: 超参数与成本。 附录 D.7 调整了信任测试的 α \alpha 水平（图 D.4）。 在默认 α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 范围内，真实基准测试的结果几乎没有变化。 更宽松的水平会允许偶然获得的分数通过，在 PortBench-Full 决策中最多可达 17% 的情况，并造成高达效用 4% 的成本；而在 PlantedMem 的信息丰富机制中，这种水平则会让 MemTrial 对确实有效的值更早采取行动。 锚点需要对参考信息有强烈的先验（§ 4.3），但无需精确的强度；只有当经验具有实际意义时，检索到更多经验才会有帮助（附录 D.7 – D.9）。 在 PortBench 上，一个决策的成本约为 0.05 美元；在相同的 LLM 支出下，Draft 的平均表现明显更差。

paragraphs.en: When an LLM portfolio agent credits an experience with the outcome of the decisions that used it, the credit tracks the market rather than the experience. MemTrial instead measures what each experience changes with a small designed experiment on every date, pools these measurements into values across dates and similar experiences, trusts the values only after they have predicted unseen dates, and until then keeps an anchored blend near a conservative reference. Where the quality of experiences is known, it achieves the highest utility among 15 methods. On real markets, where the learned values did not carry over to unseen dates, it stayed close to 1/ N N , unlike existing experience-learning agents.
paragraphs.zh: 当 LLM 智能体组合将某次经验与使用该经验的决策结果相关联时，这种关联追踪的是市场，而非经验本身。 MemTrial 则通过在每个日期上开展小型设计实验来衡量每次经验带来的变化，将这些测量值汇总为跨日期和相似经验的数值，在预测到未观测日期之前仅信任这些数值，在此之前则保持一个锚定在保守参考值附近的混合状态。 在已知经验质量的情况下，它在 15 种方法中实现了最高的效用。 在真实市场中，由于学到的数值未能延续到未观测的日期，它始终接近于 1/N，这与现有的经验学习智能体不同。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. On the real benchmarks, MemTrial’s values rarely passed the trust test, and where they did (ClassAlloc), acting on them did not beat the anchor. Its advantage there comes from the anchor, which protects the baselines just as well, so gains from memory on real markets remain to be shown. LLMs recall market outcomes from before their knowledge cutoffs, a look-ahead bias that can flatter any LLM-based method on earlier periods; PlantedMem and the months after the cutoff are free of it. When the LLM’s drafts beat the reference, as on ClassAlloc before the cutoff, the anchored action gives up most of their advantage (Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 在真实基准测试中，MemTrial 的数值很少通过信任测试；即便通过（如 ClassAlloc），依据这些数值采取行动的表现也未优于基准方法。 其在此处的优势源于基准方法本身，而基准方法同样能有效保护基线模型，因此记忆机制在真实市场中的实际增益仍有待验证。 LLM 会回忆其知识截止时间之前的市场结果，这种“提前知晓”的偏差可能使任何基于 LLM 的方法在早期阶段显得更优；PlantedMem 及其截止时间之后的月份则不存在这一问题。 当 LLM 的草案优于参考方案时（如截止时间前的 ClassAlloc），采用锚定策略的行动会使其大部分优势丧失（附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: In more detail than § 2 : MemGPT ( Packer et al., 2023 ) manages a hierarchy of memory tiers for long interactions, MemoryBank ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) stores memories and lets them fade with a rule inspired by the forgetting curve, and Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) builds a library of executable skills that it reuses when they succeed; in finance, FinCon ( Yu et al., 2024 ) updates the investment beliefs of a team of LLM agents by verbal reinforcement from realized profit and loss. These methods decide what to store, keep or reuse from the success of the episodes in which a memory took part, i.e., by outcome credit, and none of them tests whether its rule for using memory predicts future gains before acting on it.
paragraphs.zh: 与 § 2 相比，这些方法提供了更详细的说明：MemGPT（Packer 等人，2023）为长期交互管理了多层级记忆结构；MemoryBank（Zhong 等人，2024）存储记忆，并依据受遗忘曲线启发的规则让记忆逐渐淡化；Voyager（Wang 等人，2023）构建了一个可执行技能的库，并在这些技能成功时重复使用它们；在金融领域，FinCon（Yu 等人，2024）通过已实现盈亏带来的语言强化来更新 LLM 智能体团队的投资信念。 这些方法根据记忆所参与的片段是否成功来决定存储、保留或重复使用哪些内容，即依据结果带来的信用值进行判断；但其中没有任何一种方法会在采取行动前测试其记忆使用规则能否预测未来的收益。

paragraphs.en: The Shapley value ( Shapley et al., 1953 ) and the Banzhaf value ( Banzhaf III, 1964 ) are the two classic ways to divide a joint payoff among players. Data valuation adapts them to training data ( Ghorbani and Zou, 2019 ; Jia et al., 2019 ; Kwon and Zou, 2021 ; Wang and Jia, 2023 ) : Beta Shapley reweights subsets by their size to reduce noise, and Data Banzhaf weights all subsets equally, which makes it the most robust semivalue when the utility is noisy. Our contribution is the main effect of a factor in a 2 4 − 1 2^{4-1} factorial experiment ( Box et al., 2005 ) , the classic way to estimate several effects at once with few runs; Appendix C.1 shows that it equals the Banzhaf value when the three-way interaction aliased with it is negligible. Estimating what an experience does to a decision is also a problem of heterogeneous treatment effects ( Athey and Imbens, 2016 ; Künzel et al., 2019 ) . Uplift modelling ( Gutierrez and Gérardy, 2017 ) and counterfactual learning from logged decisions ( Bottou et al., 2013 ; Swaminathan and Joachims, 2015 ) estimate such effects from observational data, and online controlled experiments ( Kohavi et al., 2009 ) randomize users into groups. MemTrial instead runs the whole designed experiment on every date, so the market is held fixed within each comparison.
paragraphs.zh: Shapley值（Shapley等，1953）和Banzhaf值（Banzhaf III，1964）是分配联合收益给参与者的两种经典方法。 数据估值将这些方法应用于训练数据（Ghorbani和Zou，2019；Jia等，2019；Kwon和Zou，2021；Wang和Jia，2023）：Beta Shapley通过根据子集大小重新加权来减少噪声，而Data Banzhaf则对所有子集赋予相等的权重，这使得它在效用存在噪声时成为最稳健的半值方法。 我们的贡献相当于一个2⁴−1因子实验（Box等，2005）中某个因素的主要效应——这是一种通过少量试验同时估计多个效应的经典方法；附录C.1表明，当与之相关的三阶交互作用可以忽略不计时，该贡献值等于Banzhaf值。 估计某种经历对决策的影响也是一个异质性处理效应问题（Athey和Imbens，2016；Künzel等，2019）。 Uplift建模（Gutierrez和Gérardy，2017）以及基于记录决策的反事实学习（Bottou等，2013；Swaminathan和Joachims，2015）通过观察性数据估计此类效应，而在线控制实验（Kohavi等，2009）则通过随机分配用户到不同组别来研究这一问题。 MemTrial则是在每次迭代中完整执行整个设计好的实验，从而在每次比较中保持市场固定不变。

paragraphs.en: Mean–variance optimization ( Markowitz, 1955 ) is sensitive to errors in the estimated means and covariances, which has motivated shrinkage estimators ( Jorion, 1986 ; Ledoit and Wolf, 2003 ) , portfolios that account for parameter and model uncertainty ( Kan and Zhou, 2007 ; Garlappi et al., 2007 ) , and combinations of an optimized portfolio with 1/ N N ( Tu and Zhou, 2011 ) . DeMiguel et al. (2009) find that none of the optimized portfolios they evaluate consistently beats 1/ N N out of sample. Online portfolio selection ( Cover, 1991 ; Helmbold et al., 1998 ; Li and Hoi, 2014 ) adapts the weights over time with regret guarantees. The anchored action of MemTrial combines two of these ideas: shrinkage towards a conservative portfolio, and an online blend learned with a regularizer.
paragraphs.zh: 均值-方差优化（Markowitz，1955）对估计的均值和协方差中的误差非常敏感，这催生了收缩估计量（Jorion，1986；Ledoit 和 Wolf，2003）、考虑参数和模型不确定性的投资组合（Kan 和 Zhou，2007；Garlappi 等，2007），以及优化投资组合与 1/N 策略的组合（Tu 和 Zhou，2011）。DeMiguel 等 （2009）发现，他们评估的优化投资组合中没有任何一种在样本外能持续优于 1/N 策略。 在线投资组合选择（Cover，1991；Helmbold 等，1998；Li 和 Hoi，2014）通过具有遗憾保证的方式随时间调整权重。 MemTrial 的锚定动作结合了这两种思想：向保守型投资组合进行收缩，以及通过正则化器学习到的在线混合策略。

paragraphs.en: Prequential analysis ( Dawid, 1984 ) judges a model by its sequential out-of-sample predictions; tests of predictive accuracy ( Diebold and Mariano, 2002 ) and proper scoring rules ( Gneiting and Raftery, 2007 ) formalize such judgments. The trust test of MemTrial applies this idea to the values of experiences, as a one-sided test of whether their out-of-sample correlations with the measured contributions are positive. Safe policy improvement ( Thomas et al., 2015 ; Laroche et al., 2019 ) deploys a new policy only when it improves on a baseline with high confidence; in MemTrial, the trust test plays the role of this confidence check, and the anchored action that of the baseline policy. Finally, shrinkage across units ( Efron and Morris, 1975 ; Fay III and Herriot, 1979 ) underlies our value model.
paragraphs.zh: 预序分析（Dawid，1984）通过模型在样本外预测的序列性来评估模型；预测准确性检验（Diebold 和 Mariano，2002）以及适当的评分规则（Gneiting 和 Raftery，2007）将这些判断形式化。 MemTrial 的信任检验将这一理念应用于体验值，作为单侧检验，以判断这些体验值与所衡量贡献之间的样本外相关性是否为正。 安全策略改进（Thomas 等，2015；Laroche 等，2019）仅在高度确信新策略优于基线策略时才会部署它；在 MemTrial 中，信任检验承担了这种置信度检查的角色，而锚定动作则对应基线策略。 最后，跨单元收缩（Efron 和 Morris，1975；Fay III 和 Herriot，1979）构成了我们价值模型的基础。

paragraphs.en: Suppose that the learned values carry no information about future contributions, so that every forward score has mean zero. If the scores were independent and approximately normal, the statistic in Eq. ( 9 ) would follow a Student t t distribution with n − 1 n-1 degrees of freedom, and a single test at a fixed n n would pass with probability at most α \alpha . MemTrial uses the test as a decision rule: it applies it on every date with n ≥ 10 n\geq 10 , to the scores of the learner whose mean score is higher, and scores of nearby dates are dependent when the same experiences recur. The level α \alpha is therefore the level of one test, not the rate at which the rule passes over a run. That rate is measured where every pass is a false one: in the two PlantedMem regimes in which experiences carry no signal, the rule passed on 2.3% and 3.0% of decisions (Table D.13 ). The minimum of 10 scores and the level α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 were fixed on the development seeds, and Table D.9 varies both.
paragraphs.zh: 假设所学到的值不包含任何关于未来贡献的信息，因此每个正向得分的均值均为零。 如果这些得分相互独立且近似服从正态分布，则公式中的统计量 (9) 将服从自由度为 n−1 的学生 t 分布，在固定 n 的情况下，单次检验通过的概率最多为 α。 MemTrial 将该检验用作决策规则：它在每个 n ≥ 10 的日期上，对平均得分较高的学习者的得分进行检验；当相同的经历重复出现时，邻近日期的得分是相关的。 因此，水平 α 是单次检验的显著性水平，而非该规则在整个运行过程中通过的比率。 这一比率是在每次通过均为错误通过的情况下测量的：在两种 PlantedMem 机制中（即经历不包含任何信号），该规则分别通过了 2.3% 和 3.0% 的决策（表 D.13）。 在开发种子数据上，固定了 10 个得分的最小值以及 α = 0.05 的水平，而表 D.9 则同时变化这两个参数。

paragraphs.en: Table D.1 gives the size of each benchmark and the cost of our runs. The smallest sample is the PortBench test period (20 months), which is why we test significance across test dates; none of the PortBench differences in Table 3 is significant. The ten further InvestorBench runs of § 4.4 make 8,940 executions each (the 16 subsets, ExpeL and the three sequential agents, over 149 days and three seeds) and cost USD 1.21–16.90 each; the seven further ClassAlloc runs make 4,318 executions each and cost USD 0.38–6.01 each, and the two extra memory-free draws per date and seed of Self-consistency cost USD 6.76 in all. Replaying the sequential agents of all ten ClassAlloc runs with the feedback timing of Appendix D.3 cost USD 1.26.
paragraphs.zh: 表 D.1 列出了每个基准测试的规模以及我们运行所产生的成本。 样本最小的数据集是 PortBench 测试周期（20 个月），因此我们需要跨测试日期检验显著性；表 3 中 PortBench 的所有差异均不显著。 § 4.4 中另外十次 InvestorBench 运行每次执行 8,940 次（包括 16 个子集、ExpeL 和三种顺序智能体，跨越 149 天并使用三个种子），每次成本为 1.21–16.90 美元；另外七次 ClassAlloc 运行每次执行 4,318 次，成本为 0.38–6.01 美元；而 Self-consistency 每次日期和种子下额外进行的两次无内存抽取总共花费 6.76 美元。 使用附录 D.3 中的反馈时机，对全部十次 ClassAlloc 运行中的顺序智能体进行重播，成本为 1.26 美元。

paragraphs.en: Several methods are evaluated on the same logged drafts, so that they differ only in how they use memory. 1/ N N ( DeMiguel et al., 2009 ) holds equal weights in all assets and cash, projected to the mandate. Minimum variance ( Markowitz, 1955 ) is the long-only minimum-variance portfolio estimated from the past 60 daily returns, projected to the mandate. Memory-free (zero-shot) ( Brown et al., 2020 ) deploys the draft made without experiences. Self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2022 ) averages memory-free drafts of the same decision: on the real benchmarks, three per seed (the seed’s own draft and two further draws, made after the main runs with the same prompt, LLM and temperature); in PlantedMem, eight. Similarity retrieval ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) deploys the draft made with the two most similar or with all four retrieved experiences. FinMem ( Yu et al., 2025 ) ranks memories by similarity, recency and an importance score that is reinforced when the decision that used them earns a positive return. MemRL ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) learns a value for each memory from the rewards of the decisions that used it and selects among the most similar candidates, with ε \varepsilon -greedy exploration. Reflexion ( Shinn et al., 2023 ) writes a verbal reflection after each outcome and conditions later decisions on the most recent reflections. ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) distils insights from successful and failed decisions; on InvestorBench the LLM writes them, and on PortBench and in PlantedMem we use its insight votes (†): an experience gains a vote when the decision it took part in beats 1/ N N and loses one otherwise, and the two experiences with the most votes are used. Uplift credit ( Gutierrez and Gérardy, 2017 ) regresses the utility of the deployed decision on indicators of which experiences were used, with the utility of 1/ N N as a market control and a small ridge penalty, and uses the two experiences with the highest coefficients, exploring a random pair on 10% of dates. Counterfactual selection ( Wang and Jia, 2023 ) measures the Banzhaf contribution of each retrieved experience on every date with a realized outcome and deploys the draft with the two experiences of highest mean past contribution, without value estimation, trust test or anchor. Draft averaging ( Bates and Granger, 1969 ) deploys the average of MemTrial’s eight designed drafts.
paragraphs.zh: 多种方法在相同的已记录草案上进行评估，因此它们仅在记忆使用方式上存在差异。1/N N（DeMiguel 等，2009）在所有资产和现金中保持相等权重，并投影至授权范围。 最小方差法（Markowitz，1955）是基于过去 60 个每日收益率估算出的长期仅持有多头的最小方差投资组合，并投影至授权范围。 无记忆（零样本）方法（Brown 等，2020）采用无需经验即可生成的草案。 自洽性方法（Wang 等，2022）对相同决策的无记忆草案进行平均：在真实基准测试中，每个种子生成三个草案（该种子的自身草案以及另外两个在主要运行后使用相同提示、LLM 和温度生成的草案）；在 PlantedMem 中则生成八个。 相似性检索方法（Lewis 等，2020）采用通过最相似的两次或所有四次检索到的经验生成的草案。 FinMem（Yu 等，2025）根据相似性、近期性以及重要性得分对记忆进行排序，其中重要性得分会在使用这些记忆的决策获得正回报时得到强化。 MemRL（Zhang 等，2026）通过被使用的决策所获得的奖励为每个记忆学习一个价值，并在最相似的候选记忆中进行选择，同时采用 ε-贪心探索策略。 Reflexion（Shinn 等，2023）在每次结果出现后撰写一段文字反思，并将后续决策建立在最新的反思之上。 ExpeL（Zhao 等，2024）从成功和失败的决策中提炼洞察；在 InvestorBench 上由 LLM 撰写这些洞察，而在 PortBench 和 PlantedMem 中我们使用其洞察投票（†）：当某项经验所参与的决策击败 1/N N 时，该经验获得一票，否则失去一票，并使用得票最多的两项经验。 Uplift credit（Gutierrez 和 Gérardy，2017）将已部署决策的效用对哪些经验被使用的指标进行回归分析，其中 1/N N 的效用作为市场对照项，并加入较小的岭惩罚项；最终使用系数最高的两项经验，并在 10% 的日期上随机探索一对经验。 反事实选择方法（Wang 和 Jia，2023）在每次有实际结果的日期上衡量每项检索到经验的 Banzhaf 贡献度，并采用过去平均贡献度最高的两项经验生成草案，过程中不涉及价值估计、信任测试或锚定机制。 草案平均法（Bates 和 Granger，1969）采用 MemTrial 中八个设计草案的平均值作为最终草案。

paragraphs.en: Hedge ( Freund and Schapire, 1997 ) mixes 1/ N N and the portfolios of the memory configurations available on each benchmark (memory-free, top-4 retrieval, FinMem and MemRL, plus the benchmark’s native memory on PortBench) with exponential weights, whose learning rate is scaled as in Eq. ( 11 ). On PortBench, FinMem and MemRL select experiences from the same pool with their own memory modules; where a baseline’s own module cannot run († in Table 3 ), we re-implement its memory-scoring rule over the same experience pool. The baselines learn as follows. On PortBench, the FinMem and MemRL modules receive no feedback after July 2019, before the first decision date, and score the pool by the outcomes recorded up to then; ExpeL† is the vote rule above (ExpeL-style voting), and Reflexion writes a reflection once the outcome of each decision is known. On InvestorBench and ClassAlloc, FinMem† and MemRL† update their importance and values, and Reflexion its reflections, once the outcome of each decision is known; FinMem† and MemRL† learn from the return of their own draft over the holding period, before the mandate and fees. ExpeL’s insights are written once from the warm-up lessons. In PlantedMem, every adapted agent updates after every period. Uplift credit, Counterfactual selection, Hedge and MemTrial learn from every realized outcome on all benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: Hedge（Freund 和 Schapire，1997）将 1/N N 与每个基准测试中可用的记忆配置组合（无记忆、前 4 项检索、FinMem 和 MemRL，以及 PortBench 上的基准测试原生记忆）按指数权重进行混合，其学习率按公式（11）中的方式调整。 在 PortBench 上，FinMem 和 MemRL 使用各自的记忆模块从同一经验池中选择经验；当某个基线模型自身的模块无法运行时（表 3 中的 †），我们用相同的经验池重新实现其记忆评分规则。 基线模型的学习方式如下。 在 PortBench 上，FinMem 和 MemRL 模块在 2019 年 7 月之后、首次决策日之前不会收到任何反馈，而是根据当时已记录的结果对经验池进行评分；ExpeL† 是上述投票规则（ExpeL 风格投票），而 Reflexion 会在每次决策的结果已知后撰写反思。 在 InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc 上，FinMem† 和 MemRL† 会在每次决策的结果已知后更新其重要性和价值，而 Reflexion 则会更新其反思内容；FinMem† 和 MemRL† 会从自身草案在持有期内的收益中学习，且该学习发生在授权和费用计算之前。 ExpeL 的洞见仅在预热阶段的学习结束后撰写一次。 在 PlantedMem 中，每个经过适配的智能体在每个周期结束后都会进行更新。 Uplift credit、Counterfactual selection、Hedge 和 MemTrial 会在所有基准测试中根据每个已实现的结果进行学习。

paragraphs.en: Agents. All LLM agents use gpt-4.1-mini (2025-04-14) ( OpenAI, 2025a ) at temperature 0.7. On PortBench, a draft is one run of the benchmark’s staged agent (market interpretation, signal generation and weight optimization), which makes three LLM calls with JSON output; the retrieved experiences enter the prompt as a memory block of at most 4,096 tokens. PortBench-Raw uses the benchmark’s native prompt, which shows a price table of eight assets, and PortBench-Full extends the table to all eligible assets. On InvestorBench, a draft is one chat completion that returns a JSON object with the weights of the four stocks and cash; the prompt gives, for each stock, the close, the 1-, 5- and 20-day returns, the 20-day volatility and up to three news headlines of the day, and an invalid reply is retried once. The runs with other LLMs (§ 4.4 ) also use gpt-4.1-nano (2025-04-14) ( OpenAI, 2025a ) , gpt-5-mini (2025-08-07; minimal reasoning effort, temperature fixed by the API) ( OpenAI, 2025b ) , and, through OpenRouter, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , DeepSeek-V3.1 (non-thinking mode) ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ) , Gemini 2.5 Flash (thinking budget 0) ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) and Claude Haiku 4.5 ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , all with unchanged prompts; on InvestorBench the lessons and their embeddings are those of the main run, and on ClassAlloc each LLM writes its own lessons; the ExpeL insights and Reflexion notes are always written by the LLM under test.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体。 所有 LLM 智能体均使用 gpt-4.1-mini (2025-04-14) (OpenAI, 2025a)，温度设为 0.7。 在 PortBench 中，一次草案运行是指基准测试的分阶段智能体（市场解读、信号生成和权重优化）的一次执行，该过程会进行三次 LLM 调用并返回 JSON 输出；检索到的经验将以最多 4,096 个词元的记忆块形式进入提示。 PortBench-Raw 使用基准测试的原生提示，其中展示了一个包含八种资产的价目表；PortBench-Full 则将该表格扩展至所有符合条件的资产。 在 InvestorBench 中，一次草案运行是指一次聊天补全操作，返回一个包含四种股票和现金权重的 JSON 对象；提示会针对每只股票提供收盘价、1 天、5 天和 20 天的收益率、20 天的波动率以及当天最多三条新闻标题，若回复无效则重试一次。 使用其他 LLM 的运行（§4.4）也使用了 gpt-4.1-nano (2025-04-14) (OpenAI, 2025a)、gpt-5-mini (2025-08-07；推理努力最小，温度由 API 固定) (OpenAI, 2025b)，以及通过 OpenRouter 使用的 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (Grattafiori et al., 2024)、Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 (Yang et al., 2025)、DeepSeek-V3.1（非思考模式）(DeepSeek-AI, 2024)、Gemini 2.5 Flash（思考预算为 0）(Comanici et al., 2025) 和 Claude Haiku 4.5 (Anthropic, 2025)，所有模型均使用未更改的提示；在 InvestorBench 中，课程及其嵌入来自主运行，而在 ClassAlloc 中，每个 LLM 都会自行编写课程；ExpeL 洞察和 Reflexion 笔记始终由受测 LLM 编写。

sents.zh: 使用其他 LLM 的运行（§4.4）也使用了 gpt-4.1-nano (2025-04-14) (OpenAI, 2025a)、gpt-5-mini (2025-08-07；推理努力最小，温度由 API 固定) (OpenAI, 2025b)，以及通过 OpenRouter 使用的 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (Grattafiori et al., 2024)、Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507 (Yang et al., 2025)、DeepSeek-V3.1（非思考模式）(DeepSeek-AI, 2024)、Gemini 2.5 Flash（思考预算为 0）(Comanici et al., 2025) 和 Claude Haiku 4.5 (Anthropic, 2025)，所有模型均使用未更改的提示；在 InvestorBench 中，课程及其嵌入来自主运行，而在 ClassAlloc 中，每个 LLM 都会自行编写课程；ExpeL 洞察和 Reflexion 笔记始终由受测 LLM 编写。

paragraphs.en: ClassAlloc. Each class index averages, every day, the daily returns of PortBench’s assets in that class that have prices on both days (44 equities, 15 bond, 16 commodity, 10 real-estate and 4 cash assets); an asset listed after January 2015 enters its index only after 20 sessions of prices, because the first quotes of new listings can be wrong (one coin gains 10,200% on its third day). Decisions are made on the first session of each month from July 2015 (on 6 July, the first session with six months of history) to March 2026, the last month with 20 sessions of outcome in the data. Each decision is scored over the 20 sessions after it, and the holdings are carried to the next decision date. Every learner uses an outcome only after its 20 sessions have passed: in 9 of the 70 test months the next decision comes after 19 sessions, and that outcome is used from the decision after. The sequential agents of our runs (FinMem, MemRL and Reflexion) were replayed under this timing from the logged runs: a logged decision whose prompt is unchanged is kept, and any other decision, with the reflection written after it, is drawn anew (210 of 639 in the main run). The mandate treats equities and real estate as risky and bonds and cash as defensive, as PortBench does. Each lesson is written after the agent sees the returns of the five classes over the 20 holding sessions, its own portfolio return and that of the equal-weight portfolio, and is retrieved by text-embedding-3-small ( OpenAI, 2024 ) as on InvestorBench. FinMem’s recency decays over 4.5 months (about 90 trading days); all other settings are as on InvestorBench.
paragraphs.zh: ClassAlloc。 每个类别指数每天计算 PortBench 中该类别资产在两天内均有价格记录时的每日回报平均值（包括 44 只股票、15 种债券、16 种商品、10 种房地产和 4 种现金资产）；2015 年 1 月之后上市的资产，只有在有 20 个交易日的价格数据后才会被纳入指数，因为新上市资产的首次报价可能不准确（某枚硬币在第三天涨幅高达 10,200%）。 决策从 2015 年 7 月（7 月 6 日，即有六个月历史数据的第一个交易日）开始，到 2026 年 3 月结束，这是数据中最后一个拥有 20 个结果交易日的月份。 每个决策的评分基于其后的 20 个交易日，且持仓会延续至下一个决策日。 每个学习者只有在对应结果出现 20 个交易日后才会使用该结果：在 70 个测试月份中的 9 个月里，下一次决策会在第 19 个交易日之后做出，而该结果则从下一个决策开始被使用。 我们实验中的序列智能体（FinMem、MemRL 和 Reflexion）根据记录下来的运行过程，在此时间安排下进行了重演：提示未变的记录决策会被保留，而其他任何决策（包括其后附带的反思内容）都会被重新生成（主运行中 639 个决策中有 210 个被重新生成）。 该策略将股票和房地产视为风险资产，债券和现金视为防御性资产，这与 PortBench 的做法一致。 每次课程都是在智能体观察到五个类别在 20 个持仓交易日内的回报、自身投资组合的回报以及等权重投资组合的回报之后编写的，并通过 text-embedding-3-small（OpenAI, 2024）进行文本嵌入检索，方式与 InvestorBench 相同。 FinMem 的近期性衰减周期为 4.5 个月（约 90 个交易日）；所有其他设置均与 InvestorBench 一致。

paragraphs.en: PlantedMem. An episode runs over 132 monthly dates (Table D.1 ) with four asset classes, the equal-weighted indices of PortBench’s equities, bonds, cash and commodities, and 20-session outcomes; every decision starts from the equal-weight portfolio, and its outcome is known before the next one. Of the M = 12 M=12 (or 48) planted experiences, M / 4 M/4 are useful, M / 2 M/2 neutral and M / 4 M/4 misleading, in random order. Each experience has a home regime, drawn independently of its type; on date t t it receives the retrieval score 𝟙 [ home = g t ] + ϵ \mathbb{1}[\text{home}=g_{t}]+\epsilon with ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.5 2 ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,0.5^{2}) , where g t = 1 g_{t}=1 if the equities rose on average over the previous 60 sessions, and the four highest scores are retrieved. On each date, a retrieved experience points to an asset class c t , h c_{t,h} : a useful (misleading) experience points with probability 0.7 to the class with the highest (lowest) return over the coming 20 sessions, and otherwise, like a neutral one, to a class drawn uniformly. A draft made with the experiences S S is x S = ( 1 − β ) ​ b + β ​ 1 | S | ​ ∑ h ∈ S e c t , h x^{S}=(1-\beta)\,b+\beta\,\frac{1}{|S|}\sum_{h\in S}e_{c_{t,h}} , where b b is an allocation drawn for each draft from 2,828 logged gpt-4.1-mini allocations of PortBench (aggregated to the four classes) and e c e_{c} is the indicator of class c c ; the memory-free draft is b b . The regimes set β ∈ { 0 , 0.1 , 0.25 , 0.5 } \beta\in\{0,0.1,0.25,0.5\} , and noise only uses β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 with every experience neutral. The content feature is z h = κ ​ q h ​ e 1 + ξ h z_{h}=\kappa\,q_{h}e_{1}+\xi_{h} , with type q h ∈ { + 1 , 0 , − 1 } q_{h}\in\{+1,0,-1\} , ξ h ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I 8 ) \xi_{h}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I_{8}) , κ = 1.5 \kappa=1.5 in the regime with informative content and 0 otherwise. Usefulness is thus defined by the direction in which an experience moves the draft, and its gain in utility depends on the date and the investor. The adapted baselines act on the same retrieved experiences: FinMem† adds an importance that rises when the decision beats 1/ N N , MemRL† learns values from the utilities of the decisions that used the experiences, ExpeL† votes, and Reflexion† tilts the draft towards the classes that did best in the last three periods.
paragraphs.zh: PlantedMem。 一个实验周期覆盖 132 个每月日期（表 D.1），包含四类资产：PortBench 的等权重股票、债券、现金和商品指数，以及 20 个交易期的结果；每个决策都从等权重投资组合开始，且其结果在做出下一个决策前已知。 在 M = 12（或 48）个植入的经验中，M / 4 个有用，M / 2 个中性，M / 4 个具有误导性，且顺序随机。 每个经验都有一个所属机制，该机制与其类型独立抽取；在日期 t，它获得检索分数 𝟙 [ home = g t ] + ϵ \mathbb{1}[\text{home}=g_{t}]+\epsilon，其中 ϵ ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.5 2 ) \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,0.5^{2})；若股票在前 60 个交易期内平均上涨，则 g t = 1，此时会检索出四个最高分数。 在每个日期，一个检索到的经验会指向一个资产类别 c t , h：有用（具有误导性）的经验以 0.7 的概率指向未来 20 个交易期内回报最高（最低）的类别；否则，则像中性经验一样，均匀随机地指向一个类别。 使用经验集 S 生成的草案为 x S = ( 1 − β ) ​ b + β ​ 1 | S | ​ ∑ h ∈ S e c t , h x^{S}=(1-\beta)\,b+\beta\,\frac{1}{|S|}\sum_{h\in S}e_{c_{t,h}}，其中 b 是每次生成草案时从 PortBench 记录的 2,828 个 gpt-4.1-mini 分配方案中抽取的分配（汇总至四类资产），而 e c 是类别 c 的指示变量；无记忆草案为 b。 机制设定 β ∈ { 0 , 0.1 , 0.25 , 0.5 }，且噪声仅使用 β = 0.5，此时所有经验均为中性。 内容特征为 z h = κ ​ q h ​ e 1 + ξ h z_{h}=\kappa\,q_{h}e_{1}+\xi_{h}，其中类型 q h ∈ { + 1 , 0 , − 1 }，ξ h ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , I 8 )，在具有信息性内容的机制中 κ = 1.5，否则为 0。 因此，有用性由经验对草案的影响方向定义，而效用的增益则取决于日期和投资者。 调整后的基线方法作用于相同的检索经验：FinMem† 会添加一个重要性权重，该权重在决策优于 1/ N 时上升；MemRL† 会从使用这些经验的决策效用中学习数值；ExpeL† 会进行投票；Reflexion† 会将草案向过去三个周期表现最佳的资产类别倾斜。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval. On PortBench, the query is a short JSON text with the task description, the date, the public market features, the number of assets and the risk profile of the benchmark task. Each experience is the JSON record of an earlier decision: its allocation by asset class, the public market features at the time and the realized 20-day outcome. Both are embedded with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) (1,024 dimensions, run locally), and the four records with the highest cosine similarity are retrieved. All 338 records became available between April 2015 and July 2019, before the first decision date. On InvestorBench, the query is the day’s market context described above, each experience is a lesson of at most 700 characters that the agent wrote after seeing the outcome of a warm-up decision, and both are embedded with text-embedding-3-small. Ties are broken by experience identifier.
paragraphs.zh: 检索。 在 PortBench 中，查询是一个简短的 JSON 文本，其中包含任务描述、日期、公开市场特征、资产数量以及基准任务的风险特征。 每次经验都是之前某个决策的 JSON 记录：包括其按资产类别的配置、当时的公开市场特征以及已实现的 20 天结果。 两者均通过 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B（Zhang 等人，2025）进行嵌入（1,024 维，本地运行），并检索出余弦相似度最高的四条记录。 全部 338 条记录均于 2015 年 4 月至 2019 年 7 月期间，即首次决策日期之前，变得可用。 在 InvestorBench 中，查询是上文描述的当日市场背景，每次经验是智能体在查看热身决策结果后撰写的、最多 700 个字符的教训，两者均通过 text-embedding-3-small 进行嵌入。 若出现并列情况，则按经验标识符进行排序。

On PortBench, P θ P_{\theta} is the Euclidean projection onto the long-only portfolios whose risky share (equities, real estate and cryptocurrency) is at most M M and whose defensive share (bonds and cash) is at least m m , computed by alternating projections. On InvestorBench, negative weights are set to zero and, if the stock share exceeds min ⁡ ( M , 1 − m ) \min(M,1-m) , the stock weights are scaled down to this cap and the rest goes to cash.
paragraphs.zh: 授权。 在 PortBench 上，P θ P_{\theta} 是仅包含长期资产的组合的欧几里得投影，其中风险资产（股票、房地产和加密货币）的比例最多为 M M，防御性资产（债券和现金）的比例至少为 m m，通过交替投影计算得出。 在 InvestorBench 上，负权重被设为零；如果股票比例超过 min ⁡ ( M , 1 − m ) \min(M,1-m)，则股票权重会向下调整至该上限，剩余部分将分配给现金。

paragraphs.en: Trading costs and utility. Costs are 15 bp of the L1 distance moved. Each PortBench decision is an episode that starts from the equal-weight book, as in the benchmark, so the distance is measured from it; PlantedMem does the same. On InvestorBench, holdings drift with prices overnight and the distance is measured from the drifted holdings, so every method pays for what it actually trades. The variance term of Eq. ( 1 ) is the variance of daily portfolio returns times the number of days held (20); on InvestorBench, with one day held, it is the squared daily return.
paragraphs.zh: 交易成本与效用。成本为 L1 距离移动量的 15 个基点。每个 PortBench 决策都是一个从等权投资组合开始的回合，与基准方法一致，因此距离是从该投资组合开始测量的；PlantedMem 也采用相同方式。在 InvestorBench 中，持仓会因隔夜价格变动而发生漂移，此时距离是从漂移后的持仓开始测量的，因此每种方法都需要为其实际交易支付成本。方程 (1) 中的方差项是每日组合收益率的方差乘以持有天数（20）；而在 InvestorBench 中，由于仅持有一天，该方差项为每日收益率的平方。

paragraphs.en: Seeds. A seed means different things on the two kinds of benchmark. On the real benchmarks, a seed is an independent deployment in which every LLM draft is sampled anew. There is only one market history, so additional seeds measure only the randomness of the LLM, and each one costs a full set of paid calls (about USD 14.5 per seed on PortBench, USD 43.6 for all methods and seeds); we use three seeds and test significance across test dates, where the randomness of the market lies. In PlantedMem, a seed is a newly generated world (which experiences are useful, the retrieval noise and the resampled drafts), which costs no LLM call, so we use 100 test seeds to make the estimates precise. A standard deviation shown as 0.00 is below 0.005; this happens when MemTrial stays anchored at the reference, which does not depend on the seed.
paragraphs.zh: 种子。 在这两种基准测试中，“种子”的含义不同。 在真实基准测试中，一个“种子”代表一次独立部署，其中每个 LLM 草案都会被重新采样。 市场历史只有一个，因此额外的“种子”仅用于衡量 LLM 的随机性，而每个“种子”都需要消耗一整组付费调用（在 PortBench 上，每个“种子”约需 14.5 美元，所有方法和“种子”合计约需 43.6 美元）；我们使用三个“种子”，并在测试日期之间检验显著性，因为市场的随机性正体现在这些日期中。 在 PlantedMem 中，“种子”是一个新生成的世界（包括有用的经验、检索噪声和重新采样的草案），这不会消耗任何 LLM 调用，因此我们使用 100 个测试“种子”来提高估计的精确度。 显示为 0.00 的标准差实际上低于 0.005；这种情况发生在 MemTrial 始终锚定在参考值上时，而该参考值不依赖于“种子”。

paragraphs.en: LLM cost and learning overhead. MemTrial makes eight drafts per decision. The drafts are independent and run in parallel, so the latency of a decision is that of a single draft. With gpt-4.1-mini, one draft costs about USD 0.006 on PortBench and USD 0.0006 on InvestorBench, whose prompts are shorter, so a MemTrial decision costs about USD 0.05 and USD 0.005, respectively; the complete InvestorBench run, covering all 15 methods with three seeds, cost USD 5.09, and the ClassAlloc run USD 1.61 (Appendix D.1 ). At equal LLM spend, the relevant comparison is Draft averaging, which uses the same eight drafts and is 0.36 and 0.81 pp per month worse than MemTrial on PortBench, 1.70 bp per day worse on InvestorBench and 0.12 pp worse in PlantedMem (Table 3 ). Fitting both value models, scoring the trust test and solving Eq. ( 11 ) takes 3.6 ms per decision on average with 12 experiences and 6.9 ms with 48 experiences (95th percentiles 6.2 and 10.4 ms, one CPU core), and recording a realized outcome takes 0.1 ms, which is negligible next to a single LLM call.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 成本与学习开销。 MemTrial 每次决策会生成八份草案。 这些草案相互独立且并行运行，因此决策的延迟仅取决于单份草案的延迟。 使用 gpt-4.1-mini，一份草案在 PortBench 上的成本约为 0.006 美元，在提示较短的 InvestorBench 上则为 0.0006 美元；因此，一次 MemTrial 决策的成本分别约为 0.05 美元和 0.005 美元；完整的 InvestorBench 运行（涵盖所有 15 种方法并设置三种种子）成本为 5.09 美元，而 ClassAlloc 运行的成本为 1.61 美元（附录 D.1）。 在 LLM 支出相同的情况下，相关的比较是 Draft averaging 方法：它使用相同的八份草案，但在 PortBench 上每月比 MemTrial 差 0.36 和 0.81 个百分点，在 InvestorBench 上每天差 1.70 个基点，在 PlantedMem 中则差 0.12 个百分点（表 3）。 拟合两种价值模型、执行信任测试评分并求解方程。 （11）在平均每次决策需要 3.6 毫秒（使用 12 条经验）和 6.9 毫秒（使用 48 条经验），其第 95 百分位分别为 6.2 毫秒和 10.4 毫秒（单 CPU 核心）；记录一次实际结果仅需 0.1 毫秒，与单次 LLM 调用相比可以忽略不计。

paragraphs.en: Table D.2 splits the test-period utility into gross return, trading cost and risk penalty (utility = gross return − - cost − - risk penalty, up to rounding; mean ± \pm sd over seeds, each averaged over the investors, in % per month on PortBench and bp per day on InvestorBench). L1 is the mean distance from the equal-weight book, on which PortBench charges costs. On PortBench-Full, the memory-free draft, the top-4 retrieval draft and the average of the eight designed drafts trail 1/ N N by 0.33–0.42 pp per month, and the gap has three parts of similar size: 0.06–0.16 pp less gross return, 0.13–0.15 pp more trading cost and a 0.11–0.14 pp larger risk penalty. Each month, the LLM moves about half of the capital away from the equal-weight book (an L1 distance of 1.0–1.2, against 0.17 for 1/ N N projected to the mandate), which costs money and adds risk without earning more. On PortBench-Raw, whose prompt shows only eight assets, the drafts are also more defensive than 1/ N N : they earn 0.72–0.85 pp less gross return at a slightly smaller risk penalty. On InvestorBench, the LLM-based methods earn about the same gross return as 1/ N N (10.7–11.7 against 11.4 bp per day), but they change their portfolios substantially every day and pay 1.0–2.5 bp per day in trading costs, against 0.1 bp for 1/ N N and 0.2 bp for MemTrial. With trading costs set to zero and all methods recomputed, MemTrial included, every LLM draft still trails 1/ N N on PortBench, by 0.17–0.27 pp per month on Full and 0.68–0.81 pp on Raw, while MemTrial stays within 0.04 pp of it. In short, the drafts do not pick better assets than equal weighting, and their frequent reallocation costs money. Experience learning would have to close this gap to beat 1/ N N . Outcome credit does not close it, and MemTrial’s trust test finds that its own learned values do not close it either, so MemTrial stays near the reference.
paragraphs.zh: 表 D.2 将测试期间的效用分解为总回报、交易成本和风险惩罚（效用 = 总回报 − 成本 − 风险惩罚，四舍五入后；各种子运行结果的均值 ± 标准差，每个种子结果均对投资者取平均，单位：PortBench 为每月百分比，InvestorBench 为每日基点）。 L1 是相对于等权重投资组合的平均距离，PortBench 会据此收取成本。 在 PortBench-Full（无记忆草案）、Top-4 检索草案以及八种设计草案的平均值中，它们与 1/N N 相比每月落后 0.33–0.42 pp，这一差距由三个大致相等的部分构成：总回报低 0.06–0.16 pp、交易成本高 0.13–0.15 pp、风险惩罚大 0.11–0.14 pp。 每个月，LLM 都会将约一半的资本从等权重投资组合中转移出去（L1 距离为 1.0–1.2，而 1/N N 向授权组合投影的 L1 距离仅为 0.17），这既增加了成本又提升了风险，却并未带来更高回报。 在 PortBench-Raw 中，提示仅列出八种资产，其草案也比 1/N N 更具防御性：总回报低 0.72–0.85 pp，但风险惩罚略小。 在 InvestorBench 上，基于 LLM 的方法获得的总回报与 1/N N 大致相同（每日 10.7–11.7 bp 对比 11.4 bp），但它们每天会大幅调整投资组合，并产生每日 1.0–2.5 bp 的交易成本，而 1/N N 和 MemTrial 的交易成本分别为 0.1 bp 和 0.2 bp。 当交易成本设为零且所有方法重新计算时（包括 MemTrial），所有 LLM 草案在 PortBench 上仍落后于 1/N N：Full 版本每月落后 0.17–0.27 pp，Raw 版本落后 0.68–0.81 pp，而 MemTrial 与 1/N N 的差距保持在 0.04 pp 以内。 简而言之，这些草案并未挑选出优于等权重的资产，且频繁的重配带来了额外成本。 经验学习必须弥补这一差距，才能超越 1/N N。 结果信用未能弥合这一差距，MemTrial 的信任测试也发现其自身学习到的价值同样无法弥合，因此 MemTrial 的表现仍接近参考基准。

sents.en: With trading costs set to zero and all methods recomputed, MemTrial included, every LLM draft still trails 1/ N N on PortBench, by 0.17–0.27 pp per month on Full and 0.68–0.81 pp on Raw, while MemTrial stays within 0.04 pp of it.
sents.zh: 当交易成本设为零且所有方法重新计算时（包括 MemTrial），所有 LLM 草案在 PortBench 上仍落后于 1/N N：Full 版本每月落后 0.17–0.27 pp，Raw 版本落后 0.68–0.81 pp，而 MemTrial 与 1/N N 的差距保持在 0.04 pp 以内。

sents.en: In short, the drafts do not pick better assets than equal weighting, and their frequent reallocation costs money.
sents.zh: 简而言之，这些草案并未挑选出优于等权重的资产，且频繁的重配带来了额外成本。

sents.en: Experience learning would have to close this gap to beat 1/ N N .
sents.zh: 经验学习必须弥补这一差距，才能超越 1/N N。

sents.en: Outcome credit does not close it, and MemTrial’s trust test finds that its own learned values do not close it either, so MemTrial stays near the reference.
sents.zh: 结果信用未能弥合这一差距，MemTrial 的信任测试也发现其自身学习到的价值同样无法弥合，因此 MemTrial 的表现仍接近参考基准。

paragraphs.en: Why do some values coincide? On PortBench and InvestorBench, the three variants that change how values are learned or tested give the same numbers as MemTrial in all but two cells. This is expected and not an error. Such a change can affect a decision only when the values are acted upon, and on these two benchmarks the test (or the F-test) passes on at most 1.1% of decisions (Table D.3 ), so on all other decisions the four methods take the same anchored action. The two exceptions come from the few decisions on which the tests disagree: the content-aware learner alone passes its test by chance on a few PortBench-Raw decisions (1.94 ± \pm 0.12; observation 3), and the F-test never passes on InvestorBench, whereas MemTrial’s test passes on 0.3% of decisions (10.37 against 10.40). On ClassAlloc, the value model estimates the content term at zero on every date, so the content-aware learner coincides with the per-experience learner, and the two value-estimation variants give the same numbers as MemTrial although the test passes on 15% of decisions. Where no test passes, the anchored action stays close to the reference, which does not depend on the seed, so the sd is below 0.005; a test that passes on a few decisions of one seed raises it (0.04 for MemTrial on InvestorBench). The same steps make a difference in PlantedMem, where these variants trust their values on 15–45% of decisions and the columns differ. The anchored-action variants change what the agent does when its values are not trusted, so they matter most on PortBench and InvestorBench, where the values are almost never trusted.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么某些数值会一致？ 在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上，三种改变数值学习或测试方式的变体在所有单元格中（除两个外）都与 MemTrial 得出相同的数值。 这是预期结果，而非错误。 此类变化只有在依据这些数值做出决策时才会影响决策；在这两个基准测试中，测试（或 F 检验）最多仅通过 1.1% 的决策（表 D.3），因此所有其他决策中，四种方法都会采取相同的锚定行动。 这两个例外来自少数测试结果不一致的决策：在 PortBench-Raw 的少数决策中，仅内容感知学习机偶然通过了其测试（1.94 ± \pm 0.12；观察 3），而 F 检验在 InvestorBench 上从未通过，相比之下 MemTrial 的测试通过了 0.3% 的决策（10.37 对比 10.40）。 在 ClassAlloc 上，价值模型在每个日期都将内容项估计为零，因此内容感知学习机与逐经验学习机结果一致，且两种价值估计变体与 MemTrial 得出相同的数值，尽管测试通过了 15% 的决策。 在没有测试通过的情况下，锚定行动会保持与参考值接近，而参考值不依赖于种子值，因此标准差低于 0.005；若某个种子值的少数决策通过了测试，标准差则会升高（MemTrial 在 InvestorBench 上为 0.04）。 同样的步骤在 PlantedMem 中产生了差异，在这些变体中，它们对 15–45% 的决策信任其数值，因此各列结果有所不同。 锚定行动变体会改变智能体在其数值不被信任时的行为，因此它们在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上最为关键，因为在这两个基准测试中，数值几乎从未被信任。
