paragraphs.en: We make the following observations. (1) The trust test matters most on real markets. Without it, MemTrial acts on its learned values whenever they favour a designed subset, on 25% of PortBench and 34% of InvestorBench test decisions, and loses 0.08 pp per month on PortBench-Full, 0.24 pp on PortBench-Raw and 0.49 bp per day on InvestorBench, with a much larger spread across seeds. In PlantedMem, removing the test leaves the core average unchanged and gains 0.02 pp in the informative regime, where acting early pays off; § 4.5 shows that the test trades this small delay for protection when experiences carry no signal. On ClassAlloc, where the test passes on 15% of decisions, acting on the values does not pay either way: without the test, MemTrial loses 0.001 pp, and the F-test, which passes on 2% of decisions, gains 0.016 pp. (2) The test must look at future dates, not past ones. An in-sample F-test of whether experiences differed in the past leaves PortBench and the core regimes nearly unchanged and never passes on InvestorBench ( − 0.03 -0.03 bp per day), but it loses 0.05 pp in the informative regime: with 48 experiences, each retrieved only occasionally, the F-test, which needs repeated measurements of the same experience, passes on only 15% of decisions there, against 45% for the trust test. (3) Content-aware value estimation helps when content is informative and costs nothing otherwise. Without it, MemTrial trusts its values on only 22% of decisions in the informative regime and loses 0.05 pp. Using the content-aware learner alone, without learner selection, is as good there but costs 0.07 pp on PortBench-Raw, with a larger spread across seeds, because its chance forward scores pass the test more often (1.1% against 0.3% of PortBench decisions); selecting the learner by its forward score keeps the benefit and avoids the cost. (4) When the values are not trusted, the agent must stay anchored to the reference. Replacing the anchored blend by the draft average costs 0.36 pp (Full), 0.82 pp (Raw), 1.70 bp per day (InvestorBench) and 0.03 pp (PlantedMem, core), and learning the blend from a uniform prior ( α 0 = 0.5 \alpha_{0}=0.5 ) costs 0.14 and 0.09 pp on PortBench and 0.68 bp per day on InvestorBench.
paragraphs.zh: 我们得出以下观察结果。 (1) 在真实市场中，信任测试最为关键。 若没有该测试，MemTrial 会在其学习到的价值观有利于预设子集时采取行动：在 PortBench 的测试决策中占 25%，在 InvestorBench 中占 34%；同时，它在 PortBench-Full 上每月损失 0.08 pp，在 PortBench-Raw 上损失 0.24 pp，在 InvestorBench 上每天损失 0.49 bp，且不同种子之间的差异更大。 在 PlantedMem 中，移除该测试后核心平均值保持不变，但在信息充分的机制下可获得 0.02 pp 的增益——此时早期行动会获得回报；§4.5 显示，当经验不携带任何信号时，该测试会用这一微小延迟换取保护。 在 ClassAlloc 中，该测试通过率为 15%；根据价值观采取行动无论哪种情况都无收益：没有测试时，MemTrial 损失 0.001 pp，而 F 测试（通过率为 2%）则获得 0.016 pp 的增益。 (2) 该测试必须考察未来日期，而非过去日期。 对过去经验是否存在差异进行的样本内 F 测试几乎未改变 PortBench 和核心机制的结果，且从未在 InvestorBench 中通过（−0.03 -0.03 bp/天）；但在信息充分的机制中，它损失了 0.05 pp：由于仅有 48 次经验且每次仅偶尔被检索，需要重复测量同一经验的 F 测试在此处仅通过 15% 的决策，而信任测试的通过率为 45%。 (3) 当内容具有信息价值时，内容感知的价值估算会有所帮助；否则则不会产生额外成本。 若没有该功能，MemTrial 在信息充分的机制中仅对 22% 的决策信任其价值观，并损失 0.05 pp。 单独使用内容感知学习器（无需选择学习器）在此处的效果同样良好，但在 PortBench-Raw 上会损失 0.07 pp，且不同种子之间的差异更大——因为其随机正向得分通过测试的频率更高（PortBench 决策中为 1.1%，而信任测试为 0.3%）；通过正向得分选择学习器则既能保留收益，又能避免成本。 (4) 当价值观不被信任时，智能体必须始终锚定在参考值上。 用草案平均值替代锚定混合值将导致损失：Full 机制下为 0.36 pp，Raw 机制下为 0.82 pp，InvestorBench 机制下为每天 1.70 bp，PlantedMem 核心机制下为 0.03 pp；而基于均匀先验（α₀ = 0.5）学习混合值，则会在 PortBench 上损失 0.14 和 0.09 pp，在 InvestorBench 上每天损失 0.68 bp。

sents.en: We make the following observations.
sents.zh: 我们得出以下观察结果。

sents.en: (1) The trust test matters most on real markets.
sents.zh: (1) 在真实市场中，信任测试最为关键。

sents.en: Without it, MemTrial acts on its learned values whenever they favour a designed subset, on 25% of PortBench and 34% of InvestorBench test decisions, and loses 0.08 pp per month on PortBench-Full, 0.24 pp on PortBench-Raw and 0.49 bp per day on InvestorBench, with a much larger spread across seeds.
sents.zh: 若没有该测试，MemTrial 会在其学习到的价值观有利于预设子集时采取行动：在 PortBench 的测试决策中占 25%，在 InvestorBench 中占 34%；同时，它在 PortBench-Full 上每月损失 0.08 pp，在 PortBench-Raw 上损失 0.24 pp，在 InvestorBench 上每天损失 0.49 bp，且不同种子之间的差异更大。

sents.en: In PlantedMem, removing the test leaves the core average unchanged and gains 0.02 pp in the informative regime, where acting early pays off; § 4.5 shows that the test trades this small delay for protection when experiences carry no signal.
sents.zh: 在 PlantedMem 中，移除该测试后核心平均值保持不变，但在信息充分的机制下可获得 0.02 pp 的增益——此时早期行动会获得回报；§4.5 显示，当经验不携带任何信号时，该测试会用这一微小延迟换取保护。

sents.en: On ClassAlloc, where the test passes on 15% of decisions, acting on the values does not pay either way: without the test, MemTrial loses 0.001 pp, and the F-test, which passes on 2% of decisions, gains 0.016 pp.
sents.zh: 在 ClassAlloc 中，该测试通过率为 15%；根据价值观采取行动无论哪种情况都无收益：没有测试时，MemTrial 损失 0.001 pp，而 F 测试（通过率为 2%）则获得 0.016 pp 的增益。

sents.en: (2) The test must look at future dates, not past ones.
sents.zh: (2) 该测试必须考察未来日期，而非过去日期。

sents.en: An in-sample F-test of whether experiences differed in the past leaves PortBench and the core regimes nearly unchanged and never passes on InvestorBench ( − 0.03 -0.03 bp per day), but it loses 0.05 pp in the informative regime: with 48 experiences, each retrieved only occasionally, the F-test, which needs repeated measurements of the same experience, passes on only 15% of decisions there, against 45% for the trust test.
sents.zh: 对过去经验是否存在差异进行的样本内 F 测试几乎未改变 PortBench 和核心机制的结果，且从未在 InvestorBench 中通过（−0.03 -0.03 bp/天）；但在信息充分的机制中，它损失了 0.05 pp：由于仅有 48 次经验且每次仅偶尔被检索，需要重复测量同一经验的 F 测试在此处仅通过 15% 的决策，而信任测试的通过率为 45%。

sents.en: (3) Content-aware value estimation helps when content is informative and costs nothing otherwise.
sents.zh: (3) 当内容具有信息价值时，内容感知的价值估算会有所帮助；否则则不会产生额外成本。

sents.en: Without it, MemTrial trusts its values on only 22% of decisions in the informative regime and loses 0.05 pp.
sents.zh: 若没有该功能，MemTrial 在信息充分的机制中仅对 22% 的决策信任其价值观，并损失 0.05 pp。

sents.en: Using the content-aware learner alone, without learner selection, is as good there but costs 0.07 pp on PortBench-Raw, with a larger spread across seeds, because its chance forward scores pass the test more often (1.1% against 0.3% of PortBench decisions); selecting the learner by its forward score keeps the benefit and avoids the cost.
sents.zh: 单独使用内容感知学习器（无需选择学习器）在此处的效果同样良好，但在 PortBench-Raw 上会损失 0.07 pp，且不同种子之间的差异更大——因为其随机正向得分通过测试的频率更高（PortBench 决策中为 1.1%，而信任测试为 0.3%）；通过正向得分选择学习器则既能保留收益，又能避免成本。

sents.en: (4) When the values are not trusted, the agent must stay anchored to the reference.
sents.zh: (4) 当价值观不被信任时，智能体必须始终锚定在参考值上。

sents.en: Replacing the anchored blend by the draft average costs 0.36 pp (Full), 0.82 pp (Raw), 1.70 bp per day (InvestorBench) and 0.03 pp (PlantedMem, core), and learning the blend from a uniform prior ( α 0 = 0.5 \alpha_{0}=0.5 ) costs 0.14 and 0.09 pp on PortBench and 0.68 bp per day on InvestorBench.
sents.zh: 用草案平均值替代锚定混合值将导致损失：Full 机制下为 0.36 pp，Raw 机制下为 0.82 pp，InvestorBench 机制下为每天 1.70 bp，PlantedMem 核心机制下为 0.03 pp；而基于均匀先验（α₀ = 0.5）学习混合值，则会在 PortBench 上损失 0.14 和 0.09 pp，在 InvestorBench 上每天损失 0.68 bp。

paragraphs.en: Always keeping the reference ( q = 1 q=1 ) is as good as MemTrial in PlantedMem and slightly better on the public benchmarks (by up to 0.04 pp per month and 0.08 bp per day), because there the average draft never beats the reference; online learning matters when the reference is weak (Appendix D.8 ). ClassAlloc is such a case: there the drafts beat 1/ N N , so the draft average would gain 0.035 pp per month and the uniform prior 0.019 pp, whereas always keeping the reference loses 0.008 pp.
paragraphs.zh: 始终保留参考值（q = 1 q=1）的效果与 PlantedMem 中的 MemTrial 相当，在公开基准测试中则略胜一筹（每月最多提升 0.04 pp，每日提升 0.08 bp），因为在这些测试中，平均草案从未优于参考值；当参考值较弱时，在线学习就显得尤为重要（附录 D.8）。 ClassAlloc 就是这种情况：其中草案优于 1/N N，因此草案平均值每月会提升 0.035 pp，均匀先验则会提升 0.019 pp，而始终保留参考值则会导致损失 0.008 pp。

( 11 ) on the baseline’s own realized outcomes ( α 0 = 0.9 \alpha_{0}=0.9 , λ 0 = 4 \lambda_{0}=4 ); holdings, fees and the timing of outcomes are those of each benchmark. For Draft averaging, this is exactly the variant whose test never passes. On the real benchmarks, the anchor helps every baseline: all of them come within 1% of MemTrial on PortBench and InvestorBench, and on ClassAlloc, where the trusted decisions of MemTrial lost, all of them are ahead of it (0.621–0.635% against 0.613% per month). No difference between MemTrial and the best anchored baseline on a real benchmark is significant ( p ≥ 0.13 p\geq 0.13 , two-sided paired t t -test over test dates), and Hedge with a prior weight of 0.9 on the reference does as well. In PlantedMem, the anchor keeps the baselines close to the reference: with signal, they earn 0.787–0.838% per month against 0.788% for the reference, whereas MemTrial, which acts fully on its values once they have predicted unseen dates, earns 0.932% per month, 11% more than the best of them (Counterfactual selection; p < 0.001 p<0.001 over seeds), and 7.5% more with informative content. Without signal, the anchored baselines stay at the reference and MemTrial is 0.6% below them, the cost of its false passes.

paragraphs.en: Wealth. For every method, seed and setting, the wealth path starts at 1 and follows the net returns after the 15 bp trading fee, before the risk penalty of the utility; we divide it by the wealth path of 1/ N N in the same setting. On InvestorBench and ClassAlloc, which carry the holdings from one decision to the next, it is the value of the account from each decision date to the next (on ClassAlloc, a decision is scored over the 20 sessions after it and held until the next decision date). On PortBench, whose decisions each start from the equal-weight book, it compounds the net returns of the 20-day decision periods. The net returns are those of the portfolios deployed in the published runs: re-running the evaluation reproduces every published utility exactly, so the wealth paths need no new LLM calls. Market phases. For each benchmark we form the equal-weighted index of its equities (PortBench: the equities in the date’s universe; InvestorBench: the four stocks; ClassAlloc: the equities class) and call falling every phase from a peak of this index to the following trough in which the index lost at least 5%; all other periods are rising . This gives one falling phase on PortBench (August to October 2023, − 8.7 % -8.7\% ), one on InvestorBench (October 2020, − 8.7 % -8.7\% ) and four on ClassAlloc, the largest of which is the 2022 bear market ( − 20.6 % -20.6\% ). Survival. A run survives at a given shortfall if its wealth never fell further behind the wealth of 1/ N N than this shortfall at any time in the test period.
paragraphs.zh: 财富。 对于每种方法、初始值和设置，财富路径从 1 开始，遵循扣除 15 bp 交易费后的净回报，但不包括效用的风险惩罚；我们将该财富路径与相同设置下的 1/N 财富路径进行比较。 在 InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc 中，持仓会从一次决策延续到下一次决策；具体而言，这是每次决策日账户价值到下一次决策日的价值（在 ClassAlloc 中，一项决策的评分基于其后的 20 个会话，并一直持有至下一个决策日）。 在 PortBench 中，每次决策均从等权基准组合开始，因此会对其 20 天决策周期的净回报进行复利计算。 净回报来自已发布运行中部署的投资组合：重新运行评估将完全重现所有已公布的效用值，因此财富路径无需新的 LLM 调用。市场阶段。 对于每个基准，我们构建其股票的等权重指数（PortBench：该日期可用股票池中的股票；InvestorBench：四只股票；ClassAlloc：股票类别），并将指数从峰值下跌至随后至少下跌 5% 的谷底的整个时期定义为下跌阶段；所有其他时期均为上涨阶段。 据此，PortBench 有一个下跌阶段（2023 年 8 月至 10 月，−8.7%），InvestorBench 有一个下跌阶段（2020 年 10 月，−8.7%），ClassAlloc 则有四个下跌阶段，其中最大的是 2022 年的熊市（−20.6%）。生存性。 若在一次运行中，财富在任何测试时期内从未落后于 1/N 财富超过某个特定亏损幅度，则视为在该亏损幅度下“存活”。

paragraphs.en: Figure D.1 shows the wealth relative to 1/ N N in every setting, Figure D.2 the wealth itself, Figure D.3 InvestorBench with the other LLMs and temperatures, and Figure D.5 ClassAlloc with the other LLMs. All use gpt-4.1-mini unless stated and show the mean over three seeds, with a band of ± \pm sd for MemTrial; shading marks the market phases and the dotted line the LLM’s knowledge cutoff, as in Figure 3 . Figures D.3 and D.5 show the balanced investor; on InvestorBench, the experience pool, retrieval and test days are those of the main run. Table D.6 gives the relative wealth at the end of the test period and accumulated over the falling and the rising phases, Table D.7 the share of runs whose wealth never fell further behind that of 1/ N N than a given shortfall, with the median over runs of the largest shortfall, and Table D.8 the cumulative net return, annualized Sharpe ratio and maximum drawdown over the test period, computed from the wealth paths of Figure D.2 . In Tables D.6 and D.8 , each seed averages the settings of a benchmark (PortBench: two configurations and three investors; InvestorBench and ClassAlloc: eight LLMs and three investors); Table D.7 pools the 54 runs of each seed over the three benchmarks. All three report the mean ± \pm sd over the three seeds. On PortBench, the experience-learning agents were ahead of 1/ N N in mid-2024 in the Full configuration; the last test month (November 2024) reverses this: the equal-weighted cryptocurrency class of the universe gained 129%, and 1/ N N , which holds 10% in it for the balanced investor, gained 15%, whereas the agents’ drafts held 0–7%. Without this month, Similarity retrieval (top-4) (1.50% per month) and Hedge (1.49%) come out ahead of 1/ N N and MemTrial (1.46% each) on PortBench-Full; dropping any other single test month leaves MemTrial the best LLM-based method on both PortBench variants. On ClassAlloc, the memory-free LLM and most memory-based methods end above 1/ N N for the balanced and aggressive investors, with their gains made before the knowledge cutoff of gpt-4.1-mini; after it, every LLM-based method trails 1/ N N , MemTrial the least for every investor.
paragraphs.zh: 图 D.1 展示了每种设置下相对于 1/N N 的财富情况，图 D.2 展示了财富本身，图 D.3 展示了 InvestorBench 与其他 LLM 和温度设置的情况，而图 D.5 则展示了 ClassAlloc 与其他 LLM 的情况。 除非另有说明，所有实验均使用 gpt-4.1-mini，并显示三个种子运行结果的平均值；MemTrial 还标出了 ±\pm sd 的置信带；阴影部分表示市场阶段，虚线则表示 LLM 的知识截止日，与图 3 中的标注一致。 图 D.3 和图 D.5 展示了平衡型投资者；在 InvestorBench 中，经验池、检索日和测试日均与主运行设置相同。 表 D.6 给出了测试期结束时的相对财富以及在下跌和上涨阶段累计的财富；表 D.7 显示了那些财富从未落后于 1/N N 超过给定缺口的运行所占比例，以及各运行中最大缺口的中位数；表 D.8 则列出了基于图 D.2 中的财富路径计算出的测试期内的累计净回报、年化夏普指数和最大回撤。 在表 D.6 和表 D.8 中，每个种子均对基准设置进行了平均（PortBench：两种配置和三名投资者；InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc：八种 LLM 和三名投资者）；表 D.7 则将每个种子在三项基准测试中的 54 次运行结果合并计算。 这三个表格均报告了三个种子运行结果的平均值 ±\pm sd。 在 PortBench 的 Full 配置中，经验学习智能体在 2024 年中期领先于 1/N N；但在最后一个测试月（2024 年 11 月），这一情况被逆转：该宇宙中的等权加密货币类别上涨了 129%，而 1/N N（平衡型投资者持有其 10% 的资产）上涨了 15%，相比之下，智能体的初始配置仅持有 0–7%。 如果不考虑这个月份，在 PortBench-Full 中，Similarity 检索（前 4 项）（每月 1.50%）和 Hedge（1.49%）的表现优于 1/N N 和 MemTrial（均为 1.46%）；若排除任何其他单个测试月，MemTrial 将成为两种 PortBench 变体中表现最佳的基于 LLM 的方法。 在 ClassAlloc 中，无记忆 LLM 和大多数基于记忆的方法在平衡型和激进型投资者配置下最终表现优于 1/N N，且其收益均产生于 gpt-4.1-mini 的知识截止日之前；在此之后，所有基于 LLM 的方法均落后于 1/N N，其中 MemTrial 在所有投资者配置中的落后幅度最小。

sents.en: Figures D.3 and D.5 show the balanced investor; on InvestorBench, the experience pool, retrieval and test days are those of the main run.
sents.zh: 图 D.3 和图 D.5 展示了平衡型投资者；在 InvestorBench 中，经验池、检索日和测试日均与主运行设置相同。

sents.en: Table D.6 gives the relative wealth at the end of the test period and accumulated over the falling and the rising phases, Table D.7 the share of runs whose wealth never fell further behind that of 1/ N N than a given shortfall, with the median over runs of the largest shortfall, and Table D.8 the cumulative net return, annualized Sharpe ratio and maximum drawdown over the test period, computed from the wealth paths of Figure D.2 .
sents.zh: 表 D.6 给出了测试期结束时的相对财富以及在下跌和上涨阶段累计的财富；表 D.7 显示了那些财富从未落后于 1/N N 超过给定缺口的运行所占比例，以及各运行中最大缺口的中位数；表 D.8 则列出了基于图 D.2 中的财富路径计算出的测试期内的累计净回报、年化夏普指数和最大回撤。

sents.en: In Tables D.6 and D.8 , each seed averages the settings of a benchmark (PortBench: two configurations and three investors; InvestorBench and ClassAlloc: eight LLMs and three investors); Table D.7 pools the 54 runs of each seed over the three benchmarks.
sents.zh: 在表 D.6 和表 D.8 中，每个种子均对基准设置进行了平均（PortBench：两种配置和三名投资者；InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc：八种 LLM 和三名投资者）；表 D.7 则将每个种子在三项基准测试中的 54 次运行结果合并计算。

sents.en: All three report the mean ± \pm sd over the three seeds.
sents.zh: 这三个表格均报告了三个种子运行结果的平均值 ±\pm sd。

sents.en: On PortBench, the experience-learning agents were ahead of 1/ N N in mid-2024 in the Full configuration; the last test month (November 2024) reverses this: the equal-weighted cryptocurrency class of the universe gained 129%, and 1/ N N , which holds 10% in it for the balanced investor, gained 15%, whereas the agents’ drafts held 0–7%.
sents.zh: 在 PortBench 的 Full 配置中，经验学习智能体在 2024 年中期领先于 1/N N；但在最后一个测试月（2024 年 11 月），这一情况被逆转：该宇宙中的等权加密货币类别上涨了 129%，而 1/N N（平衡型投资者持有其 10% 的资产）上涨了 15%，相比之下，智能体的初始配置仅持有 0–7%。

sents.en: Without this month, Similarity retrieval (top-4) (1.50% per month) and Hedge (1.49%) come out ahead of 1/ N N and MemTrial (1.46% each) on PortBench-Full; dropping any other single test month leaves MemTrial the best LLM-based method on both PortBench variants.
sents.zh: 如果不考虑这个月份，在 PortBench-Full 中，Similarity 检索（前 4 项）（每月 1.50%）和 Hedge（1.49%）的表现优于 1/N N 和 MemTrial（均为 1.46%）；若排除任何其他单个测试月，MemTrial 将成为两种 PortBench 变体中表现最佳的基于 LLM 的方法。

sents.en: On ClassAlloc, the memory-free LLM and most memory-based methods end above 1/ N N for the balanced and aggressive investors, with their gains made before the knowledge cutoff of gpt-4.1-mini; after it, every LLM-based method trails 1/ N N , MemTrial the least for every investor.
sents.zh: 在 ClassAlloc 中，无记忆 LLM 和大多数基于记忆的方法在平衡型和激进型投资者配置下最终表现优于 1/N N，且其收益均产生于 gpt-4.1-mini 的知识截止日之前；在此之后，所有基于 LLM 的方法均落后于 1/N N，其中 MemTrial 在所有投资者配置中的落后幅度最小。

paragraphs.en: Summary over all settings. Every method gains over the test periods (for the balanced investor, 1/ N N ends at 1.61, 1.19 and 1.82 times its initial wealth on PortBench-Full, InvestorBench and ClassAlloc), so the methods differ mainly relative to 1/ N N . Averaged over all settings, including every LLM, the experience-learning agents fall behind 1/ N N on PortBench and InvestorBench mostly while markets rise (by 9.8–11.5% and 2.0–4.1% over the rising phases), and on ClassAlloc they lose 1.5–3.5% against 1/ N N over the falling phases, which include the 2022 bear market (Table D.6 ). Over the falling phases of InvestorBench and ClassAlloc, MemTrial loses less than the memory-free LLM and every experience-learning agent (0.06% and 0.9%, against 0.38–0.65% and 1.5–3.5%). Its terminal wealth is the highest of all LLM-based methods in 38 of the 39 PortBench and InvestorBench settings and within 1.4% of 1/ N N , and its Sharpe ratio and maximum drawdown are the closest to those of 1/ N N (Table D.8 ). On ClassAlloc, the memory-free LLM ends 0.3% above 1/ N N .
paragraphs.zh: 所有设置的汇总。 在所有测试周期中，每种方法的表现均优于 1/ N N（对于平衡投资者，在 PortBench-Full、InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc 上的最终财富分别为初始财富的 1.61 倍、1.19 倍和 1.82 倍），因此这些方法的主要差异是相对于 1/ N N 而言的。 在所有设置（包括每种 LLM）中取平均值，经验学习智能体在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上主要于市场上涨时落后于 1/ N N（上涨阶段分别落后 9.8–11.5% 和 2.0–4.1%），而在 ClassAlloc 上，它们在下跌阶段相对于 1/ N N 损失了 1.5–3.5%，这些下跌阶段包括 2022 年的熊市（表 D.6）。 在 InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc 的下跌阶段中，MemTrial 的损失小于无记忆 LLM 和所有经验学习智能体（分别为 0.06% 和 0.9%，而后者为 0.38–0.65% 和 1.5–3.5%）。 在 39 个 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 设置中的 38 个中，其最终财富是所有基于 LLM 的方法中最高的，且与 1/ N N 的差距在 1.4% 以内；其夏普指数和最大回撤也最接近 1/ N N（表 D.8）。 在 ClassAlloc 上，无记忆 LLM 的最终结果比 1/ N N 高出 0.3%。

paragraphs.en: We vary one hyperparameter at a time around the frozen setting: the trust test (Figure D.4 and Table D.9 ), the number of retrieved experiences k k and the design (Table D.10 ), and the strength of the anchor (Appendix D.8 , Table D.11 ). Tables report the mean ± \pm sd over seeds, in % per month (bp per day on InvestorBench). In Table D.10 , Drafts is the number of drafts per decision; a draft is one LLM call on InvestorBench and one run of the three-call agent on PortBench, so the LLM cost grows in proportion. On the real benchmarks, drafts were generated for all 16 subsets of the four retrieved experiences, so every design with k ≤ 4 k\leq 4 is evaluated offline from these drafts, without new LLM calls. In PlantedMem, drafts are resampled, which also allows k = 5 k=5 and 6; these results come from a separate run on 50 test seeds (15–64) with common random numbers across designs, in which the default scores 0.868% per month (0.87 on 100 seeds in Table 3 ), and are shown with three decimals. Trust rates, with sd, are in Table D.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们每次仅改变一个超参数，围绕其固定设置进行调整：信任测试（图 D.4 和表 D.9）、检索经验的数量 k 以及设计（表 D.10），还有锚点的强度（附录 D.8，表 D.11）。 表格报告了各种子运行结果的均值 ± sd，单位为每月百分比（InvestorBench 上为每日基点）。 在表 D.10 中，“Drafts”表示每个决策的草案数量；一份草案对应 InvestorBench 上的一次 LLM 调用，以及 PortBench 上一次包含三次调用的智能体运行，因此 LLM 成本会相应增长。 在实际基准测试中，针对检索到的四种经验的所有 16 个子集都生成了草案，因此每个满足 k ≤ 4 的设计都基于这些草案进行离线评估，无需新的 LLM 调用。 在 PlantedMem 中，草案会被重新采样，这也支持 k = 5 和 6；这些结果来自在 50 个测试种子（15–64）上进行的独立运行，各设计共享随机数。其中默认设置的成绩为每月 0.868%（表 3 中 100 个种子上的成绩为 0.87），并以三位小数显示。 信任率及其 sd 见表 D.3。

paragraphs.en: We make the following observations. (1) The test level trades protection against speed. Levels up to 0.05 give identical results on PortBench, because at these levels the test passes on at most 0.3% of PortBench decisions. At α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 and 0.2, chance forward scores pass the test on 5% and 12% of PortBench decisions; α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 gains 0.03 pp on PortBench-Full but costs 0.03 pp on PortBench-Raw, and α = 0.2 \alpha=0.2 costs 0.03 and 0.08 pp, with a larger spread across seeds. In PlantedMem, a looser test trusts the values earlier and more often (on 28% of core decisions at α = 0.01 \alpha=0.01 against 41% at α = 0.2 \alpha=0.2 ), which helps in the informative regime (0.84% against 0.88%). On InvestorBench, all levels stay within 0.05 bp per day of each other. The frozen level α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 sits between these regimes. (2) The minimum number of forward scores (5, 10 or 20) changes the InvestorBench result by at most 0.03 bp per day and no other result at two decimals. (3) More retrieved experiences help when experiences matter, with diminishing returns per draft. In PlantedMem, the core utility rises from 0.812% per month with k = 2 k=2 (4 drafts) to 0.868 with k = 4 k=4 (8 drafts), 0.896 with k = 5 k=5 (16 drafts) and 0.909 with k = 6 k=6 (32 drafts): going from 8 to 16 drafts adds 0.03 pp, and doubling again to 32 drafts adds 0.01 pp. (4) At equal cost, the half fraction is the better design , because it measures one more experience with the same number of drafts. With 4 drafts, k = 3 k=3 in a half fraction beats k = 2 k=2 in a full factorial (0.829% against 0.812%); with 8 drafts, k = 4 k=4 in a half fraction matches k = 3 k=3 in a full factorial (0.868% against 0.865%) and trusts its values more often (35% against 29%); with 16 drafts, k = 5 k=5 in a half fraction beats k = 4 k=4 in a full factorial (0.896% against 0.889%). (5) On the real benchmarks , where the values are rarely trusted, k k and the design barely matter on PortBench (1.95–2.01% per month). On InvestorBench, every other design passes the test more often (on 2–11% of decisions), on values that do not carry over to the next day, and loses 0.13–0.44 bp per day against the default; the full factorial at k = 4 k=4 , for example, doubles the drafts and loses 0.41 bp per day.
paragraphs.zh: 我们得出以下观察结果。 (1) 测试级别以牺牲速度为代价换取保护性。 在 0.05 及以下的级别中，PortBench 上的结果完全相同，因为在此类级别下，测试最多仅通过 PortBench 决策的 0.3%。 当 α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 和 0.2 时，随机正向得分分别通过 PortBench 决策的 5% 和 12%；α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 在 PortBench-Full 上提升了 0.03 pp，但在 PortBench-Raw 上损失了 0.03 pp；而 α = 0.2 \alpha=0.2 分别损失了 0.03 和 0.08 pp，且不同种子之间的差异更大。 在 PlantedMem 中，较宽松的测试更早、更频繁地信任这些值（在 α = 0.01 \alpha=0.01 时，核心决策的信任率为 28%，而在 α = 0.2 \alpha=0.2 时则为 41%），这在信息丰富的场景下更有帮助（分别为 0.84% 和 0.88%）。 在 InvestorBench 上，所有级别的每日差异均未超过 0.05 bp。 固定级别 α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 介于这些场景之间。 (2) 正向得分的最小数量（5、10 或 20）最多只会使 InvestorBench 的结果变化 0.03 bp/天，且不会改变其他保留两位小数的结果。 (3) 当经验重要时，检索更多经验会有所帮助，但每次草案的边际收益会逐渐递减。 在 PlantedMem 中，核心效用从 k = 2 k=2（4 份草案）时的每月 0.812% 上升到 k = 4 k=4（8 份草案）时的 0.868%，k = 5 k=5（16 份草案）时的 0.896%，以及 k = 6 k=6（32 份草案）时的 0.909%：从 8 份草案增加到 16 份草案带来了 0.03 pp 的提升，而再次翻倍至 32 份草案仅增加了 0.01 pp。 (4) 在成本相同的情况下，半数设计是更优的选择，因为它在保持相同草案数量的同时多测量了一次经验。 使用 4 份草案时，半数设计中的 k = 3 k=3 优于全因子设计中的 k = 2 k=2（0.829% 对比 0.812%）；使用 8 份草案时，半数设计中的 k = 4 k=4 与全因子设计中的 k = 3 k=3 结果一致（0.868% 对比 0.865%），且更频繁地信任其值（35% 对比 29%）；使用 16 份草案时，半数设计中的 k = 5 k=5 优于全因子设计中的 k = 4 k=4（0.896% 对比 0.889%）。 (5) 在真实基准测试中，由于这些值很少被信任，k k 和设计对 PortBench 的影响微乎其微（每月 1.95–2.01%）。 在 InvestorBench 上，其他所有设计都更频繁地通过测试（在决策的 2–11% 中），但针对不会延续到第二天的值时，它们每日会损失 0.13–0.44 bp；例如，k = 4 k=4 的全因子设计使草案数量翻倍，但每日损失了 0.41 bp。

sents.zh: 在 PlantedMem 中，核心效用从 k = 2 k=2（4 份草案）时的每月 0.812% 上升到 k = 4 k=4（8 份草案）时的 0.868%，k = 5 k=5（16 份草案）时的 0.896%，以及 k = 6 k=6（32 份草案）时的 0.909%：从 8 份草案增加到 16 份草案带来了 0.03 pp 的提升，而再次翻倍至 32 份草案仅增加了 0.01 pp。

sents.en: (4) At equal cost, the half fraction is the better design , because it measures one more experience with the same number of drafts.
sents.zh: (4) 在成本相同的情况下，半数设计是更优的选择，因为它在保持相同草案数量的同时多测量了一次经验。

sents.en: With 4 drafts, k = 3 k=3 in a half fraction beats k = 2 k=2 in a full factorial (0.829% against 0.812%); with 8 drafts, k = 4 k=4 in a half fraction matches k = 3 k=3 in a full factorial (0.868% against 0.865%) and trusts its values more often (35% against 29%); with 16 drafts, k = 5 k=5 in a half fraction beats k = 4 k=4 in a full factorial (0.896% against 0.889%).
sents.zh: 使用 4 份草案时，半数设计中的 k = 3 k=3 优于全因子设计中的 k = 2 k=2（0.829% 对比 0.812%）；使用 8 份草案时，半数设计中的 k = 4 k=4 与全因子设计中的 k = 3 k=3 结果一致（0.868% 对比 0.865%），且更频繁地信任其值（35% 对比 29%）；使用 16 份草案时，半数设计中的 k = 5 k=5 优于全因子设计中的 k = 4 k=4（0.896% 对比 0.889%）。

sents.en: (5) On the real benchmarks , where the values are rarely trusted, k k and the design barely matter on PortBench (1.95–2.01% per month).
sents.zh: (5) 在真实基准测试中，由于这些值很少被信任，k k 和设计对 PortBench 的影响微乎其微（每月 1.95–2.01%）。

sents.en: On InvestorBench, every other design passes the test more often (on 2–11% of decisions), on values that do not carry over to the next day, and loses 0.13–0.44 bp per day against the default; the full factorial at k = 4 k=4 , for example, doubles the drafts and loses 0.41 bp per day.
sents.zh: 在 InvestorBench 上，其他所有设计都更频繁地通过测试（在决策的 2–11% 中），但针对不会延续到第二天的值时，它们每日会损失 0.13–0.44 bp；例如，k = 4 k=4 的全因子设计使草案数量翻倍，但每日损失了 0.41 bp。

paragraphs.en: We therefore keep k = 4 k=4 with eight drafts: in PlantedMem its gain over the reference per draft (0.011 pp) is close to the largest (0.012 pp, for k = 3 k=3 in a half fraction), and on InvestorBench it is the best design. A larger k k is worth its cost only when experiences are known to matter. (6) The anchor matters more than its exact strength (Table D.11 ). paragraphs.en: When does MemTrial trust its values? Table D.13 shows how often the trust test passes in each regime of PlantedMem. When experiences carry no signal, MemTrial acts on its values on only 2–3% of decisions, below the nominal 5% level of a single test. The trust rate rises with the influence of experiences, from 14% at β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 to 65% at β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 and 85% at β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 , and with 48 experiences it rises from 26% to 45% when content becomes informative, because the content-aware learner then predicts the contributions of rarely seen experiences. On PortBench, the test passed on 1 of 360 test decisions and on 14 of 1,008 decisions over all months, consistent with Table 1 , where the effect of experiences on real decisions is rarely detectable. On InvestorBench, it passed on only 0.3% of decisions, even though experiences change most daily decisions detectably: the values learned from past days do not carry over to the following days, and the mean forward score of the learned values, averaged over investors and seeds, is − 0.07 -0.07 . The test thus responds to whether learned values transfer to unseen dates, not to whether experiences matter on a given date.
paragraphs.zh: MemTrial 在什么情况下会信任其价值观？ 表 D.13 展示了在 PlantedMem 的每种机制中，信任测试通过的频率。 当经验不携带任何信号时，MemTrial 仅在 2–3% 的决策中依据其价值观行动，低于单次测试名义上的 5% 水平。 随着经验影响力的增强，信任率从 β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 时的 14% 上升到 β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 时的 65% 和 β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 时的 85%；当内容变得具有信息价值时，在拥有 48 次经验的情况下，该比率从 26% 上升到 45%，因为此时内容感知型学习器能够预测罕见经验所带来的影响。 在 PortBench 上，该测试在 360 次测试决策中仅通过了 1 次，在所有月份中总共通过了 1,008 次决策中的 14 次，这与表 1 的结果一致——经验对实际决策的影响通常难以察觉。 在 InvestorBench 上，该测试仅在 0.3% 的决策中通过，尽管经验对每日决策的大部分变化都具有可检测的影响：从过往日期学到的价值观无法延续到后续日期，且这些已学价值观的平均前瞻得分（在所有投资者和初始种子中取平均）为 −0.07 -0.07。 因此，该测试反映的是已学价值观能否迁移到未见的日期，而非经验在特定日期是否具有实际意义。

paragraphs.en: Where does MemTrial gain and where does it lose? Table D.14 breaks the PlantedMem results down by regime. When experiences carry no signal, acting on learned values is costly: without its trust test, MemTrial falls 0.01–0.03 pp below the reference, and Counterfactual selection falls up to 0.13 pp below it, whereas MemTrial stays at the reference. When experiences matter, MemTrial gains up to 0.30 pp over the reference, but it gives up 0.01–0.03 pp to Counterfactual selection, because it waits for forward evidence before acting; the exception is the informative regime, where content-aware value estimation puts it 0.01 pp ahead. Averaged over the core regimes, protection outweighs delay ( + 0.02 +0.02 pp, p = 0.001 p=0.001 ; Table 3 ). Outcome credit (MemRL†) never gains from experiences, even at β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 , because its credit follows the market.
paragraphs.zh: MemTrial 在哪些方面有所增益，又在哪些方面有所损失？ 表 D.14 按不同机制细分了 PlantedMem 的结果。 当经验不携带任何信号时，依据已学习的价值采取行动会付出代价：在没有信任测试的情况下，MemTrial 的表现比参考值低 0.01–0.03 pp，而 Counterfactual selection 则低至 0.13 pp；相比之下，MemTrial 的表现与参考值保持一致。 当经验具有意义时，MemTrial 相比参考值的增益最高可达 0.30 pp，但它会向 Counterfactual selection 让出 0.01–0.03 pp，因为它会在行动前等待正向证据；例外情况是信息丰富的机制，其中内容感知的价值评估使其领先 0.01 pp。 在所有核心机制中取平均值后，保护效应超过了延迟效应（+0.02 +0.02 pp，p = 0.001 p=0.001；表 3）。 结果归因（MemRL†）从未从经验中获得增益，即使在 β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 时也是如此，因为其归因结果跟随市场变动。

sents.zh: MemTrial 在哪些方面有所增益，又在哪些方面有所损失？

sents.en: Table D.14 breaks the PlantedMem results down by regime.
sents.zh: 表 D.14 按不同机制细分了 PlantedMem 的结果。

sents.en: When experiences carry no signal, acting on learned values is costly: without its trust test, MemTrial falls 0.01–0.03 pp below the reference, and Counterfactual selection falls up to 0.13 pp below it, whereas MemTrial stays at the reference.
sents.zh: 当经验不携带任何信号时，依据已学习的价值采取行动会付出代价：在没有信任测试的情况下，MemTrial 的表现比参考值低 0.01–0.03 pp，而 Counterfactual selection 则低至 0.13 pp；相比之下，MemTrial 的表现与参考值保持一致。

sents.en: When experiences matter, MemTrial gains up to 0.30 pp over the reference, but it gives up 0.01–0.03 pp to Counterfactual selection, because it waits for forward evidence before acting; the exception is the informative regime, where content-aware value estimation puts it 0.01 pp ahead.
sents.zh: 当经验具有意义时，MemTrial 相比参考值的增益最高可达 0.30 pp，但它会向 Counterfactual selection 让出 0.01–0.03 pp，因为它会在行动前等待正向证据；例外情况是信息丰富的机制，其中内容感知的价值评估使其领先 0.01 pp。

sents.en: Averaged over the core regimes, protection outweighs delay ( + 0.02 +0.02 pp, p = 0.001 p=0.001 ; Table 3 ).
sents.zh: 在所有核心机制中取平均值后，保护效应超过了延迟效应（+0.02 +0.02 pp，p = 0.001 p=0.001；表 3）。

sents.en: Outcome credit (MemRL†) never gains from experiences, even at β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 , because its credit follows the market.
sents.zh: 结果归因（MemRL†）从未从经验中获得增益，即使在 β = 0.5 \beta=0.5 时也是如此，因为其归因结果跟随市场变动。

paragraphs.en: What if the reference is weak? On PortBench, InvestorBench and PlantedMem, the reference is never beaten by the average draft, so always keeping it ( q = 1 q=1 ) is as good as MemTrial; on ClassAlloc, where the average draft beats 1/ N N by 0.03 pp per month, it is 0.008 pp worse (Figure 4 ). To test the online learning of the anchored action, we replace the reference in PlantedMem with the 1/ N N portfolio, which ignores the investor’s risk aversion and is about 0.18 pp per month worse than the average draft there. Table D.15 shows that, if it always kept 1/ N N when its values are not trusted, MemTrial would stay near 1/ N N (0.71% per month on the core regimes). The anchored action instead learns to move towards the drafts (0.75%), and a uniform prior moves faster (0.81%). In every regime, the learned blend is at least as good as always keeping 1/ N N . Never acting on its values, MemTrial would earn only 0.62%, so with a weak reference the learned values matter even more. The prior weight α 0 \alpha_{0} therefore sets a trade-off: a high prior protects when the reference is strong (Table D.11 ), and a low prior adapts faster when it is weak.
paragraphs.zh: 如果参考基准较弱会怎样？ 在 PortBench、InvestorBench 和 PlantedMem 上，平均策略从未超越参考基准，因此始终保留参考基准（q = 1）的效果与 MemTrial 相当；而在 ClassAlloc 上，由于平均策略每月比 1/N 高出 0.03 pp，采用参考基准的效果则差 0.008 pp（图 4）。 为了测试锚定动作的在线学习能力，我们将 PlantedMem 中的参考基准替换为 1/N 组合，该组合忽略了投资者的风险厌恶倾向，且在此场景下比平均策略每月差约 0.18 pp。 表 D.15 显示，如果 MemTrial 在无法信任其数值时始终保留 1/N，它将保持在 1/N 附近（核心制度下为每月 0.71%）。 相比之下，锚定动作会学习向策略结果靠拢（0.75%），而均匀先验则调整得更快（0.81%）。 在所有制度中，学习得到的混合策略至少与始终保留 1/N 的效果一样好。 如果 MemTrial 从不依据其数值采取行动，它将仅获得 0.62%，因此当参考基准较弱时，学习得到的数值就显得尤为重要。 因此，先验权重 α₀ 设定了一种权衡：较高的先验权重在参考基准较强时能提供保护（表 D.11），而较低的先验权重则在参考基准较弱时能更快适应。

paragraphs.en: Table D.16 splits the ClassAlloc results at the knowledge cutoff of gpt-4.1-mini (June 2024; % per month, mean ± \pm sd over seeds, averaged over the three investors). Before the cutoff, every LLM-based method except FinMem and Reflexion beats 1/ N N , by up to 0.12 pp per month (Self-consistency); after it, every LLM-based method trails 1/ N N , MemTrial the least (0.746% against 0.787%) and the memory-free draft by 0.08 pp. As on the other benchmarks, outcome credit tracks the market (Spearman correlation 0.97, Table 1 ), and the retrieved experiences change the decision detectably in 53–57 of the 71 months. Over all 71 months, the memory-free draft beats 1/ N N by 0.03 pp per month, but no form of memory improves on it: retrieval, the experience-learning agents and the credit-based learners earn 0.59–0.65%, against 0.66% for the memory-free draft and 0.69% for Self-consistency (Table 3 ). The difference between the periods before and after the cutoff is not significant ( p = 0.36 p=0.36 , Welch t t -test). The trust test of MemTrial passed on none of the decisions of 2020, on 3% of those of 2021 and on 13–33% of those of each later year, and on 0%, 39% and 4% of the decisions of the three seeds. On the 93 decisions on which it passed, the trusted draft earned 0.05 0.05 pp less (s.e. 0.07 0.07 ) than the anchored blend it replaced, and more on 48% of them.
paragraphs.zh: 表 D.16 在 gpt-4.1-mini 的知识截止日（2024 年 6 月）处对 ClassAlloc 的结果进行了划分（每月百分比，均值 ± \pm sd，基于多个种子并取三名投资者的平均值）。 在截止日之前，除 FinMem 和 Reflexion 外的所有基于 LLM 的方法都优于 1/N N，优势最高可达每月 0.12 个百分点（自我一致性方法）；在截止日之后，所有基于 LLM 的方法均落后于 1/N N，其中 MemTrial 的差距最小（0.746% 对比 0.787%），而无记忆草案则落后 0.08 个百分点。 与其他基准测试一样，结果信用度与市场走势一致（斯皮尔曼相关系数为 0.97，见表 1），并且在 71 个月中有 53–57 个月，检索到的经验对决策产生了可检测的影响。 在整个 71 个月中，无记忆草案每月比 1/N N 高出 0.03 个百分点，但任何形式记忆的方法都未能超越它：检索方法、经验学习智能体和信用 기반 学习者获得的收益为 0.59–0.65%，而无记忆草案为 0.66%，自我一致性方法为 0.69%（见表 3）。 截止日之前和之后的两个时期之间的差异并不显著（p = 0.36 p=0.36，韦尔奇 t 检验）。 MemTrial 的信任测试在 2020 年的所有决策中均未通过，在 2021 年的决策中通过了 3%，而在之后每一年的决策中通过率分别为 13–33%；对于三个种子的决策，其通过率分别为 0%、39% 和 4%。 在 MemTrial 通过的 93 项决策中，受信任的草案收益比其取代的锚定混合方案低 0.05 0.05 个百分点（标准误为 0.07 0.07），但在其中 48% 的决策中收益更高。

paragraphs.en: Table D.17 summarizes every configuration of § 4.4 : on InvestorBench, in bp per day (1/ N N earns 10.45 in every configuration), with the experience pool, retrieval and test days of the main run; on ClassAlloc, in % per month (1/ N N earns 0.623), where each LLM writes its own warm-up lessons. The temperature is 0.7 unless stated, and gpt-5-mini runs at the temperature fixed by its API. Best other LLM-based method is the best of the 12 LLM-based baselines; Improv. and the trust rate are defined as in Table 3 , and p p is the one-sided paired t t -test over test dates. Tables D.18 and D.19 give every method on InvestorBench (the column for temperature 0.7 is the main run), and Table D.20 every method on ClassAlloc; all report the mean ± \pm sd over seeds, averaged over the three investors.
paragraphs.zh: 表 D.17 总结了 § 4.4 中的每种配置：在 InvestorBench 上，以每日 bp 为单位（1/N N 在每种配置中均赚取 10.45），并包含主运行中的经验池、检索和测试天数；在 ClassAlloc 上，以每月 % 为单位（1/N N 赚取 0.623），其中每个 LLM 都会自行编写热身课程。 除非另有说明，否则温度设为 0.7，而 gpt-5-mini 的运行温度则由其 API 固定。 其他基于 LLM 的最佳方法是 12 种基于 LLM 的基线方法中的最佳者；“改进”和“信任率”的定义如表 3 所示，而 p p 是对测试日期进行单侧配对 t 检验所得的结果。 表 D.18 和 D.19 列出了 InvestorBench 上的所有方法（温度 0.7 的列为主运行），表 D.20 则列出了 ClassAlloc 上的所有方法；所有表格均报告了在多个种子值上的均值 ± \pm 标准差，并对三位投资者进行了平均。

paragraphs.zh: 在每种 InvestorBench 配置中，表现最佳的 LLM 基线模型每天可获得 8.97–9.71 bp 的收益，1/ N N 为 10.45，而 MemTrial 则为 9.84–10.54。

paragraphs.en: Table D.20 gives every method of Table D.17 b on ClassAlloc, Figure D.5 the wealth relative to 1/ N N , and Table D.21 the results before and after each LLM’s own knowledge cutoff (utility minus that of 1/ N N , mean over seeds; Months counts the test months before and after the cutoff). For Claude Haiku 4.5 we use the end of its training data, July 2025 (its reliable-knowledge cutoff is February 2025); Qwen3-235B and DeepSeek-V3.1 have no published knowledge cutoff. Each LLM writes its own warm-up lessons, which are embedded and retrieved as in the main run. The memory-free draft beats 1/ N N over the whole test period with four of the eight LLMs (gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-5-mini, Qwen3-235B and Claude Haiku 4.5). Of the six LLMs whose knowledge cutoff is published, it trails 1/ N N after the cutoff with five (by 0.06–0.09 pp per month), which is what one would expect if the LLMs had seen the earlier outcomes during pretraining; with Claude Haiku 4.5, it beats 1/ N N also in the eight months after the cutoff (by 0.08 pp). MemTrial stays within 0.021 pp per month of 1/ N N with every LLM; with gpt-5-mini and Qwen3-235B, whose memory-free drafts beat 1/ N N by the widest margins, its anchor gives up most of their advantage.
paragraphs.zh: 表 D.20 给出了表 D.17 中 ClassAlloc 上的所有方法 b、图 D.5 中相对于 1/NN 的财富值，以及表 D.21 中每个 LLM 自身知识截止期前后（效用减去 1/NN 的效用，按种子取均值；“月份”统计截止期前后的测试月份）的结果。 对于 Claude Haiku 4.5，我们使用其训练数据的结束时间——2025 年 7 月（其可靠知识截止期为 2025 年 2 月）；Qwen3-235B 和 DeepSeek-V3.1 尚未公布知识截止期。 每个 LLM 都会自行编写热身课程，这些课程在嵌入和检索方式上与主运行流程一致。 在无记忆草案中，有四个 LLM（gpt-4.1-mini、gpt-5-mini、Qwen3-235B 和 Claude Haiku 4.5）在整个测试周期内的表现优于 1/NN。 在六个已公布知识截止期的 LLM 中，有五个在截止期之后表现逊于 1/NN（每月落后 0.06–0.09 个百分点），这与预期一致——即这些 LLM 在预训练阶段已经接触过早期结果；而对于 Claude Haiku 4.5，它在截止期后的八个月内也优于 1/NN（领先 0.08 个百分点）。 MemTrial 在所有 LLM 上的表现与 1/NN 的差距始终控制在每月 0.021 个百分点以内；对于 gpt-5-mini 和 Qwen3-235B，它们的无记忆草案原本以最大幅度优于 1/NN，但 MemTrial 的基准模型几乎完全失去了这一优势。

sents.en: MemTrial stays within 0.021 pp per month of 1/ N N with every LLM; with gpt-5-mini and Qwen3-235B, whose memory-free drafts beat 1/ N N by the widest margins, its anchor gives up most of their advantage.
sents.zh: MemTrial 在所有 LLM 上的表现与 1/NN 的差距始终控制在每月 0.021 个百分点以内；对于 gpt-5-mini 和 Qwen3-235B，它们的无记忆草案原本以最大幅度优于 1/NN，但 MemTrial 的基准模型几乎完全失去了这一优势。

paragraphs.en: The LLMs were trained on text that may describe the test periods, a source of look-ahead bias. We ran two checks on ClassAlloc, at a total cost of USD 3.87.
paragraphs.zh: 这些大型语言模型是在可能描述测试期的文本上训练的，这可能导致了提前知晓偏差。 我们对 ClassAlloc 进行了两次检查，总成本为 3.87 美元。

paragraphs.en: Memorization probe. For each of the 129 ClassAlloc decision dates (58 warm-up and 71 test months, July 2015 to March 2026), we gave each LLM only the date and asked for the return of each asset class over the 20 trading days for which a decision is held, with no market data and no memory (prompt in Appendix G.2 ); three draws per date, at the temperature of the runs. We compare the answers with the realized returns before and after each LLM’s knowledge cutoff in two ways. Absolute recall is the correlation over months between recalled and realized returns, averaged over the four risky classes. Relative recall is the correlation after removing each class’s mean and each month’s mean, that is, of which class did better than usual in which month, which is what matters for beating 1/ N N . Table D.22 gives the mean ± \pm sd over the three draws; each LLM has 102–121 dates before its cutoff, warm-up months included, and 8–27 after it. Every LLM whose cutoff is published recalls the outcomes before its cutoff (absolute recall 0.10–0.63, relative recall 0.06–0.50) and hardly at all after it ( − 0.16 -0.16 to + 0.09 +0.09 and − 0.10 -0.10 to + 0.01 +0.01 ). Gemini 2.5 Flash recalls the most, and Qwen3-235B and DeepSeek-V3.1, whose cutoffs are not published, have an absolute recall of 0.27 and 0.22 over all months. The advantage of the memory-free draft before the cutoff does not grow with recall: with Gemini 2.5 Flash, which recalls the most, it beats 1/ N N by only 0.008 pp per month before the cutoff, against 0.157 pp with gpt-5-mini (Table D.21 ).
paragraphs.zh: 记忆测试。 对于 129 个 ClassAlloc 决策日期中的每一个（58 个预热月和 71 个测试月，时间范围从 2015 年 7 月到 2026 年 3 月），我们仅向每个 LLM 提供日期，并要求其返回在决策生效的 20 个交易日中各类资产的回报率，不提供任何市场数据或记忆（提示词见附录 G.2）；每个日期进行三次抽取，温度值与运行时的温度一致。 我们通过两种方式将答案与每个 LLM 知识截止日期的前后实际回报率进行比较。 绝对召回率是各个月份中召回回报与实际回报之间的相关性，并对四个风险资产类别取平均值。 相对召回率是在去除各类别均值和每月均值后计算的相关性，即判断哪一类在哪个月份的表现优于平均水平，这正是超越 1/N 策略的关键。 表 D.22 给出了三次抽取的平均值 ± 标准差；每个 LLM 在其知识截止日期之前有 102–121 个日期（包括预热月），之后则有 8–27 个日期。 所有已公布知识截止日期的 LLM 都能召回截止日期之前的结果（绝对召回率为 0.10–0.63，相对召回率为 0.06–0.50），但在截止日期之后的结果几乎无法召回（−0.16 至 +0.09，以及 −0.10 至 +0.01）。 Gemini 2.5 Flash 的召回能力最强，而 Qwen3-235B 和 DeepSeek-V3.1 的知识截止日期未公开，它们在所有月份中的绝对召回率分别为 0.27 和 0.22。 截止日期之前无记忆草稿的优势并不会随召回率的提升而增强：以召回能力最强的 Gemini 2.5 Flash 为例，在截止日期之前，它每月仅比 1/N 策略高出 0.008 个百分点，而 gpt-5-mini 的差距则为 0.157 个百分点（表 D.21）。

paragraphs.en: Dates hidden. We repeated the ClassAlloc runs of gpt-4.1-mini and gpt-5-mini (three seeds each, with the two extra draws of Self-consistency) with no calendar date shown to the LLM: the market context omits its date line, the warm-up lessons are stored and retrieved without their date, and the ExpeL insight prompt lists the lessons without their dates. Everything else is unchanged. The lessons and reflections are written by the LLM from the dateless context, and none of the 58 warm-up lessons of either run mentions a year or a month. Table D.23 compares these runs with those that show the dates (mean ± \pm sd over seeds, averaged over the three investors). Hiding the dates leaves the pattern of the memory-free draft intact: with gpt-4.1-mini, it beats 1/ N N by 0.13 pp per month before the cutoff and trails it by 0.10 pp after (0.08 and 0.08 with the dates shown); with gpt-5-mini, by 0.14 and 0.07 pp (0.16 and 0.06). Over all 71 test months, it beats 1/ N N by 0.06 and 0.07 pp (0.03 and 0.09 with the dates shown). MemTrial stays within 0.02 pp per month of 1/ N N ( + 0.006 +0.006 with gpt-4.1-mini and − 0.017 -0.017 with gpt-5-mini; trust rates 0.0% and 6.6%) and, after the cutoff, trails it by 0.02 and 0.03 pp, against 0.10 and 0.07 pp for the memory-free draft.
paragraphs.zh: 日期已隐藏。 我们重复执行了 gpt-4.1-mini 和 gpt-5-mini 的 ClassAlloc 运行（每种模型各使用三个种子，并额外进行两次自我一致性抽选），但未向 LLM 显示任何日历日期：市场背景中省略了日期行，热身课程在存储和检索时也不包含日期，而 ExpeL 洞察提示则列出了课程但省略了日期。 其余一切保持不变。 课程与反思由 LLM 基于无日期的上下文生成，且两次运行中的 58 节热身课程均未提及任何年份或月份。 表 D.23 将这些运行与显示日期的运行进行了比较（均值 ± \pm 标准差，基于多个种子计算，并对三位投资者取平均）。 隐藏日期后，无记忆草稿的模式保持不变：对于 gpt-4.1-mini，在截止日期前，其表现每月比 1/ N N 高出 0.13 个百分点，而在截止日期后则低出 0.10 个百分点（显示日期时分别为 0.08 和 0.08）；对于 gpt-5-mini，差异分别为 0.14 和 0.07 个百分点（显示日期时分别为 0.16 和 0.06）。 在所有 71 个测试月份中，其表现比 1/ N N 高出 0.06 和 0.07 个百分点（显示日期时分别为 0.03 和 0.09）。 MemTrial 与 1/ N N 的差距始终在每月 0.02 个百分点以内（使用 gpt-4.1-mini 时差异为 +0.006，使用 gpt-5-mini 时为 −0.017；信任率分别为 0.0% 和 6.6%）；而在截止日期之后，其表现分别比 1/ N N 低出 0.02 和 0.03 个百分点，相比之下，无记忆草稿的差距则为 0.10 和 0.07 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Figure D.6 brings these checks together with Table D.21 . The LLMs thus recall dated market outcomes, but the advantage of the memory-free draft before the cutoff does not depend on being told the date. It may come from recognizing a period from the returns shown, or from allocations that happened to suit the markets of 2020–2024. Either way, it applies to all LLM-based methods alike, and PlantedMem is free of it.
paragraphs.zh: 图 D.6 将这些检验与表 D.21 整合在一起。 因此，大型语言模型会回忆过时的市场结果，但在截止时间之前，无记忆草案的优势并不依赖于被告知具体日期。 这种优势可能源于根据所显示的收益率识别出某个时期，或者源于恰好适合 2020–2024 年市场的配置。 无论哪种情况，这都同样适用于所有基于大型语言模型的方法，而 PlantedMem 则不受此影响。

paragraphs.en: To test on months that gpt-4.1-mini, the LLM of the PortBench runs, cannot have seen, we extended the monthly PortBench stream with the decision dates that follow 2024-12-02 under the same calendar rule (the first trading day of each month; a month is skipped when its 20-day holding window would overlap the previous one). This gives twelve dates from 2025-01-02 to 2026-02-02; March 2025, December 2025 and March 2026 are skipped by the overlap rule, and April 2026 has no complete holding window before the data end on 2026-04-16. Everything else is identical to the original months: the experience pool and the FinMem and MemRL providers (which receive no feedback after July 2019), the 19 arms per date, both agents, gpt-4.1-mini at temperature 0.7, three seeds, and the code that builds the inputs and runs the agents, which was reused unchanged. Before any new month was run, the inputs of all 59 original months were rebuilt with the same code and compared byte by byte with the frozen inputs, including the hash of every first LLM request; they were identical. The six Reflexion chains continue from their state after 2024-12-02. The evaluation reuses the code of the main results, run forward over all 71 dates without re-tuning, and reproduces the 2019–2024 results exactly.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在 gpt-4.1-mini（PortBench 所使用的 LLM）未曾见过的月份上进行测试，我们根据相同的日历规则（即每月的第一个交易日；若某个月的 20 天持有期与前一月的持有期重叠，则该月将被跳过），将月度 PortBench 数据流扩展至 2024-12-02 之后的决策日期。 这样便得到了从 2025-01-02 到 2026-02-02 的十二个日期；根据重叠规则，2025 年 3 月、2025 年 12 月和 2026 年 3 月被跳过，而 2026 年 4 月在数据截止日 2026-04-16 之前没有完整的持有期。 其余所有设置均与原始月份完全一致：经验池、FinMem 和 MemRL 提供商（这些提供商在 2019 年 7 月之后不再接收反馈）、每个日期的 19 个分支、两种智能体、温度为 0.7 的 gpt-4.1-mini、三个种子值，以及用于构建输入和运行智能体的代码（该代码未经修改地重复使用）。 在运行任何新月份之前，我们使用相同的代码重新构建了全部 59 个原始月份的输入，并将其与冻结的输入进行了逐字节比对，包括每次 LLM 首次请求的哈希值；结果完全一致。 六个 Reflexion 链从 2024-12-02 之后的状态继续运行。 评估过程重用了主要结果的代码，在未进行重新调优的情况下，向前运行覆盖全部 71 个日期，并精确复现了 2019–2024 年的结果。

paragraphs.en: The publisher’s price files have gaps in this period: 18 large equities (including AAPL, MSFT and NVDA) have no prices from 10 December 2024 to 24 January 2025 and after 19 February 2026, MATIC-USD ends on 24 March 2025 but remains in the agent’s market view until June 2025, and INDS lacks 24 October 2025. As for December 2024 in the original months, a month in which any execution held an asset without a price is dropped for that agent. This removes six of the twelve months (January, April, May, June and October 2025, and February 2026) and leaves 2025-02-03, 2025-07-01, 2025-08-01, 2025-09-02, 2025-11-03 and 2026-01-02 for both agents. The new runs cost USD 9.29 for 1,368 executions and USD 0.48 for the Reflexion chains.

paragraphs.en: Table D.24 reports the six new months and all eleven test months after the knowledge cutoff of gpt-4.1-mini (June 2024), averaged over the three investors. Over the eleven months, MemTrial is the best LLM-based method with both agents and stays close to 1/ N N (0.14 and 0.01 pp per month below it), while the other LLM-based methods trail 1/ N N by 0.36–1.57 pp; its values never passed the trust test after the cutoff. In the six new months alone, the memory-free draft of PortBench-Full beat 1/ N N by 0.80 pp per month, and MemTrial, still anchored at 1/ N N , gained only 0.06 pp; on PortBench-Raw, every LLM-based method is within 0.17 pp of 1/ N N . With six months, no difference involving MemTrial is significant.
paragraphs.zh: 表 D.24 报告了 gpt-4.1-mini（2024 年 6 月）知识截止日之后的六个新月份以及全部十一个测试月份的数值，并对三位投资者进行了平均。 在这十一个月中，MemTrial 是两种智能体配置下表现最佳的基于 LLM 的方法，且其结果始终接近 1/ N N（每月分别低于该值 0.14 和 0.01 个百分点），而其他基于 LLM 的方法则比 1/ N N 落后 0.36–1.57 个百分点；在知识截止日之后，MemTrial 的数值从未通过信任测试。 仅在这六个新月份中，PortBench-Full 的无记忆版本每月比 1/ N N 高出 0.80 个百分点，而 MemTrial 仍锚定在 1/ N N 水平，仅增加了 0.06 个百分点；在 PortBench-Raw 上，所有基于 LLM 的方法与 1/ N N 的差距均未超过 0.17 个百分点。 在六个月的测试中，涉及 MemTrial 的任何差异均不显著。

paragraphs.en: This appendix follows MemTrial through two monthly decisions on ClassAlloc (balanced investor), on 1 April and 1 September 2022. Both lie in the largest falling phase of the test period, in which the equal-weight equity index lost 21% between January and the end of September 2022 (Appendix D.6 ). The retrieved lessons depend only on the date, so all seeds see the same four lessons; the drafts, contributions and learned values differ by seed. In seed 1 the trust test passed on 1 April and narrowly failed on 1 September ( p = 0.058 p=0.058 ); in seeds 0 and 2 it passed on neither date. The two dates thus show one decision that acted on the learned values and one that kept the anchored action. Table E.1 a lists the eight designed drafts of seed 1 on both dates: the lessons each draft was given, its weights in % (Eq. equities, Bd. bonds, Cm. commodities, RE real estate) and its utility in % over the following 20 trading days, with the deployed draft in bold (on 1 September seed 1 deployed the anchored blend) and, in the last row, the realized return of each class over these 20 days. Table E.1 b gives the contributions (Contr.) and learned values of the retrieved lessons in seed 1, in pp. Table E.1 c gives the trust test and the action in each seed: the number n n of forward scores, their mean ρ ¯ \bar{\rho} , the p p -value of the test, the action and its utility in %, with trusted decisions in bold; the column 1/ N N gives the utility of moving to 1/ N N from the same holdings, which differs slightly across seeds because of trading costs.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录记录了 MemTrial 在 2022 年 4 月 1 日和 9 月 1 日针对 ClassAlloc（平衡投资者）作出的两项月度决策。 这两项决策均发生在测试阶段最大的下跌区间内，在此期间，等权重股票指数从 2022 年 1 月到 9 月底下跌了 21%（附录 D.6）。 检索到的课程仅取决于日期，因此所有种子都看到相同的四门课程；而草案、贡献度和学习值则因种子而异。 在种子 1 中，信任测试于 4 月 1 日通过，但在 9 月 1 日险些失败（p = 0.058 p=0.058）；而在种子 0 和 2 中，两次测试均未通过。 因此，这两个日期分别体现了一项基于学习值作出的决策，以及一项维持锚定行动的决策。 表 E.1 a 列出了种子 1 在两个日期下的八项设计草案：每份草案所依据的课程、其权重（%）（Eq. 股票，Bd. 债券，Cm. 商品，RE 房地产），以及在未来 20 个交易日内的收益（%）；已部署的草案以粗体显示（9 月 1 日种子 1 部署了锚定组合），最后一行则列出了各类资产在这 20 天内的实际回报。 表 E.1 b 给出了种子 1 中检索到的课程所对应的贡献度（Contr.）和学习值，单位为百分点（pp）。 表 E.1 c 展示了每个种子的信任测试结果和行动：前向得分的数量 n n、其均值 ρ ¯ \bar{\rho}、测试的 p p 值、具体行动及其收益（%），其中可信决策以粗体显示；第 1/ N N 列表示从相同持仓转向 1/ N N 策略的收益，由于交易成本的存在，该数值在不同种子间略有差异。

paragraphs.en: In December 2015, equities and real estate showed strong recent gains with moderate volatility, while commodities declined sharply. I overweighted equities and real estate, avoided commodities, and held cash. Despite this, bonds and real estate declined significantly, hurting returns. In similar scenarios, diversify more cautiously, temper bond exposure during rising volatility, and avoid complacency from recent positive trends.
paragraphs.zh: 2015年12月，股票和房地产近期表现强劲且波动温和，而大宗商品则大幅下跌。 我增持了股票和房地产，回避了大宗商品，并持有了现金。 尽管如此，债券和房地产仍显著下跌，对回报造成了负面影响。 在类似情境中，应更谨慎地分散投资，在波动上升时适度减少债券配置，并避免因近期的积极趋势而掉以轻心。

sents.en: In December 2015, equities and real estate showed strong recent gains with moderate volatility, while commodities declined sharply.
sents.zh: 2015年12月，股票和房地产近期表现强劲且波动温和，而大宗商品则大幅下跌。

sents.en: I overweighted equities and real estate, avoided commodities, and held cash.
sents.zh: 我增持了股票和房地产，回避了大宗商品，并持有了现金。

sents.en: Despite this, bonds and real estate declined significantly, hurting returns.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，债券和房地产仍显著下跌，对回报造成了负面影响。

sents.en: In similar scenarios, diversify more cautiously, temper bond exposure during rising volatility, and avoid complacency from recent positive trends.
sents.zh: 在类似情境中，应更谨慎地分散投资，在波动上升时适度减少债券配置，并避免因近期的积极趋势而掉以轻心。

paragraphs.en: In August 2016, equities and bonds showed steady gains with low volatility, while commodities declined sharply and real estate dipped despite strong prior returns. I overweighted equities and real estate, underweighted commodities and cash. The portfolio outperformed due to equities and bonds. In similar conditions, maintain exposure to stable asset classes and reduce commodities when short-term momentum weakens.
paragraphs.zh: 2016年8月，股票和债券在低波动性下稳步上涨，而大宗商品则大幅下跌，房地产尽管前期回报强劲，但也出现下滑。 我超配了股票和房地产，低配了大宗商品和现金。 该投资组合因股票和债券的表现而优于基准。 在类似的市场条件下，应维持对稳定资产类别的配置，并在短期动量减弱时减少大宗商品配置。

sents.en: In August 2016, equities and bonds showed steady gains with low volatility, while commodities declined sharply and real estate dipped despite strong prior returns.
sents.zh: 2016年8月，股票和债券在低波动性下稳步上涨，而大宗商品则大幅下跌，房地产尽管前期回报强劲，但也出现下滑。

sents.en: I overweighted equities and real estate, underweighted commodities and cash.
sents.zh: 我超配了股票和房地产，低配了大宗商品和现金。

sents.en: The portfolio outperformed due to equities and bonds.
sents.zh: 该投资组合因股票和债券的表现而优于基准。

sents.en: In similar conditions, maintain exposure to stable asset classes and reduce commodities when short-term momentum weakens.
sents.zh: 在类似的市场条件下，应维持对稳定资产类别的配置，并在短期动量减弱时减少大宗商品配置。

paragraphs.en: In May 2017, equities and real estate showed strong recent gains and moderate volatility, while commodities lagged with negative returns and high volatility. I overweighted equities and real estate, underweighted commodities, and outperformed the equal-weight portfolio. In similar conditions, favor assets with positive momentum and manageable volatility, reducing exposure to weak, volatile sectors like commodities.
paragraphs.zh: 2017年5月，股票和房地产近期表现强劲且波动性适中，而大宗商品则表现滞后，出现负回报和高波动性。 我提高了股票和房地产的权重，降低了大宗商品的权重，并跑赢了等权投资组合。 在类似的市场条件下，应偏好具有正向动量且波动性可控的资产，同时减少对大宗商品这类弱势且波动性高的板块的配置。

sents.en: In May 2017, equities and real estate showed strong recent gains and moderate volatility, while commodities lagged with negative returns and high volatility.
sents.zh: 2017年5月，股票和房地产近期表现强劲且波动性适中，而大宗商品则表现滞后，出现负回报和高波动性。

sents.en: I overweighted equities and real estate, underweighted commodities, and outperformed the equal-weight portfolio.
sents.zh: 我提高了股票和房地产的权重，降低了大宗商品的权重，并跑赢了等权投资组合。

sents.en: In similar conditions, favor assets with positive momentum and manageable volatility, reducing exposure to weak, volatile sectors like commodities.
sents.zh: 在类似的市场条件下，应偏好具有正向动量且波动性可控的资产，同时减少对大宗商品这类弱势且波动性高的板块的配置。

paragraphs.en: In April 2018, equities showed recent weakness but strong 6-month gains; bonds were stable with low volatility; commodities mildly positive; real estate mixed signals. I favored equities and bonds over cash, yielding a slightly better return than equal weights. In similar conditions, maintain diversified exposure but overweight assets with solid medium-term momentum and manageable volatility for balanced growth.
paragraphs.zh: 2018年4月，股票近期表现疲软，但6个月累计涨幅强劲；债券保持稳定，波动性较低；商品市场略有上涨；房地产市场的信号则好坏参半。 我倾向于选择股票和债券而非现金，这一配置带来的回报略高于等权重配置。 在类似的市场环境下，应维持多元化的资产配置，但对具有稳健中期动能且波动性可控的资产进行超配，以实现平衡增长。

sents.en: In April 2018, equities showed recent weakness but strong 6-month gains; bonds were stable with low volatility; commodities mildly positive; real estate mixed signals.
sents.zh: 2018年4月，股票近期表现疲软，但6个月累计涨幅强劲；债券保持稳定，波动性较低；商品市场略有上涨；房地产市场的信号则好坏参半。

sents.en: I favored equities and bonds over cash, yielding a slightly better return than equal weights.
sents.zh: 我倾向于选择股票和债券而非现金，这一配置带来的回报略高于等权重配置。

sents.en: In similar conditions, maintain diversified exposure but overweight assets with solid medium-term momentum and manageable volatility for balanced growth.
sents.zh: 在类似的市场环境下，应维持多元化的资产配置，但对具有稳健中期动能且波动性可控的资产进行超配，以实现平衡增长。

paragraphs.en: In October 2019, real estate and equities showed strong recent returns with moderate volatility, while bonds declined. Allocating higher weights to real estate (35%) and equities (30%) capitalized on momentum, delivering a portfolio return above the equal-weight benchmark. In similar cases, emphasize assets with strong momentum and moderate risk, but maintain diversification to manage downside risks.
paragraphs.zh: 2019年10月，房地产和股票近期表现强劲，波动性适中，而债券则出现下跌。 提高房地产（35%）和股票（30%）的配置比例以利用其上涨势头，使投资组合的回报率超过了等权重基准。 在类似情况下，应重点关注具有强劲势头和适度风险的资产，但需保持多样化配置以管理下行风险。

sents.en: In October 2019, real estate and equities showed strong recent returns with moderate volatility, while bonds declined.
sents.zh: 2019年10月，房地产和股票近期表现强劲，波动性适中，而债券则出现下跌。

sents.en: Allocating higher weights to real estate (35%) and equities (30%) capitalized on momentum, delivering a portfolio return above the equal-weight benchmark.
sents.zh: 提高房地产（35%）和股票（30%）的配置比例以利用其上涨势头，使投资组合的回报率超过了等权重基准。

sents.en: In similar cases, emphasize assets with strong momentum and moderate risk, but maintain diversification to manage downside risks.
sents.zh: 在类似情况下，应重点关注具有强劲势头和适度风险的资产，但需保持多样化配置以管理下行风险。

paragraphs.en: 1 April 2022. Equities had fallen 5.4% over three months but risen 3.2% in the last month, and commodities had risen 21.6% over three months. Three of the lessons (L18/04, L16/08 and L17/05) describe months in which overweighting assets with positive momentum paid off; L15/12 describes one in which it did not and warns against complacency after recent gains. All eight drafts of seed 1, including the one without lessons, put 35% in equities (1/ N N : 20%) and 20–30% in real estate (Table E.1 a), so this tilt comes from the LLM’s reading of the market rather than from the lessons. The lessons changed the drafts only slightly, and mostly for the worse: three of the four contributions are negative, and the drafts that used L17/05 earned 0.42 pp less on average than those that did not. The 11 forward scores of seed 1 so far had a mean of 0.24 and passed the trust test ( p = 0.045 p=0.045 ), so MemTrial deployed the draft with the highest total learned value (L18/04 and L15/12). Equities then fell 8.1% and real estate 7.5%, and the decision earned − 5.48 -5.48 %, against − 3.83 -3.83 % for 1/ N N . In seeds 0 and 2 the test did not pass ( p = 0.12 p=0.12 and 0.16), and the anchored action, with a weight of 0.835 on 1/ N N , earned − 4.08 -4.08 % and − 4.10 -4.10 %.
paragraphs.zh: 2022年4月1日。 三个月内，股票下跌了5.4%，但在最后一个月上涨了3.2%；商品价格在三个月内上涨了21.6%。 其中三个经验教训（L18/04、L16/08和L17/05）描述了那些对具有正向动量的资产进行超配并获得回报的月份；而L15/12则描述了一个未能获利的月份，并警告不要因近期的收益而自满。 种子1的全部八个版本（包括未包含经验教训的版本）都将35%配置于股票（1/ N N : 20%），20–30%配置于房地产（表E.1 a），因此这种倾斜源于LLM对市场解读的结果，而非经验教训本身。 这些经验教训仅对版本进行了轻微调整，且多数调整带来了负面影响：四个贡献中有三个为负值，而使用L17/05的版本平均收益比未使用的版本低0.42个百分点。 目前种子1的11个前瞻性得分均值为0.24，并通过了信任测试（ p = 0.045 p=0.045 ），因此MemTrial部署了总学习价值最高的版本（L18/04和L15/12）。 随后股票下跌了8.1%，房地产下跌了7.5%，这一决策的收益为−5.48%（-5.48%），而1/ N N 的收益为−3.83%（-3.83%）。 在种子0和2中，测试未通过（ p = 0.12 p=0.12 和0.16），锚定行动的权重为0.835（针对1/ N N ），其收益分别为−4.08%（-4.08%）和−4.10%（-4.10%）。

paragraphs.en: 1 September 2022. Every risky class had lost money over the past one, three and six months, and all eight drafts of seed 1 were defensive, with 10–15% in equities and 20–40% in cash. The drafts that used L19/10 held 35–40% in cash, against 20–30% for those that did not, and L19/10 had the largest contribution ( + 0.73 +0.73 pp). In seed 1 the test narrowly failed ( p = 0.058 p=0.058 ; 16 forward scores, mean 0.17), so MemTrial kept the anchored action, with a weight of 0.875 on 1/ N N , which earned − 5.91 -5.91 %, against − 6.06 -6.06 % for 1/ N N ; the draft it would have deployed (L18/04 and L19/10: 40% cash, 30% bonds, 10% equities) earned − 3.89 -3.89 %. In seeds 0 and 2 ( p = 0.29 p=0.29 and 0.42), the anchored action earned − 5.84 -5.84 % and − 5.79 -5.79 %.
paragraphs.zh: 2022年9月1日。 在过去一个月、三个月和六个月中，每个风险类别都出现了亏损，且种子1的八份草案均为防御型配置，其中股票占10%–15%，现金占20%–40%。 使用L19/10的草案现金占比为35%–40%，而未使用的草案现金占比为20%–30%；L19/10的贡献最大（+0.73，即+0.73个百分点）。 在种子1中，测试以微弱差距未通过（p = 0.058；16个预测得分，均值为0.17），因此MemTrial保留了锚定操作，在1/N上赋予0.875的权重，收益为−5.91%，而1/N的收益为−6.06%；它本应部署的草案（L18/04和L19/10：现金40%，债券30%，股票10%）的收益为−3.89%。 在种子0和2中（p = 0.29和0.42），锚定操作的收益分别为−5.84%和−5.79%。

paragraphs.en: What the case shows. First, contributions are measured on the same date, so the part of the outcome that all drafts share cancels: on both dates every draft had a utility between − 6.1 -6.1 % and − 3.8 -3.8 %, which outcome credit would charge to every lesson used, yet the contributions separate the lessons by tenths of a pp. Second, the contributions are noisy and the learned values are small: L18/04 helped on both dates ( + 0.12 +0.12 and + 0.28 +0.28 pp) and L17/05 hurt on both ( − 0.42 -0.42 and − 0.21 -0.21 pp), but after shrinkage all values in seed 1 are below 0.02 pp in absolute value, so the deployed draft is decided by small differences. Third, the trust test decides whether MemTrial takes on the drafts’ market exposure: in April, when every draft overweighted equities before a fall, acting on the values cost 1.66 pp against 1/ N N ; in September, when every draft was defensive, the test narrowly failed and the anchored action gave up the 2.02 pp by which the selected draft beat it. Over all 71 months, acting on the values did not pay on ClassAlloc: on the 93 decisions on which the test passed, the trusted draft earned 0.05 0.05 pp less (s.e. 0.07 0.07 ) than the anchored blend it replaced, and the variant whose test never passes is 0.016 pp per month better (Figure 4 ). Keeping part of the anchor even on trusted decisions is a natural extension (Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: 该案例所揭示的内容。 首先，贡献度是在同一日期测量的，因此所有草案共有的结果部分会被抵消：在两个日期中，每个草案的效用都在 −6.1% 至 −3.8% 之间，这一结果信用会归因于所使用的每一节课程，但贡献度则按小数点后十分之一百分点的差异区分各门课程。 其次，贡献度存在噪声，且学习到的数值很小：L18/04 在两个日期中都有帮助（+0.12 和 +0.28 个百分点），而 L17/05 则在两个日期中都有负面影响（−0.42 和 −0.21 个百分点），但经过收缩处理后，种子 1 中的所有数值绝对值均低于 0.02 个百分点，因此最终部署的草案取决于微小的差异。 第三，信任测试决定了 MemTrial 是否采用草案的市场敞口：在四月，当所有草案在股市下跌前都过度配置了股票时，依据这些数值采取行动的成本为 1.66 个百分点，而基准值为 1/N；在九月，当所有草案都采取防御策略时，该测试以微弱差距失败，锚定行动放弃了所选草案比其高出 2.02 个百分点的优势。 在所有 71 个月中，依据这些数值采取行动并未在 ClassAlloc 上产生收益：在测试通过的 93 次决策中，受信任的草案收益比其替代的锚定组合低 0.05 个百分点（标准误差为 0.07），而从未通过测试的变体版本每月则好 0.016 个百分点（图 4）。 即使在受信任的决策中保留部分锚定配置，也是一种自然的扩展（附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: This appendix gives the prompts used on the three real benchmarks, copied from the logged requests. Text in angle brackets is filled in at run time, and […] marks lines omitted here. On each benchmark, all LLM-based methods use the same prompts and differ only in the memory block that follows the market context (Table G.1 ); the other LLMs of § 4.4 receive the same prompts unchanged. The drafts of all 16 subsets of the four retrieved lessons are logged on every date and seed, so the methods in the second row of Table G.1 differ only in which draft they deploy or how they combine the drafts. On InvestorBench and ClassAlloc, a decision is one chat completion with a system and a user message, and an invalid reply is answered once with a retry message; on PortBench, a draft is one run of the benchmark’s three-stage agent, without retries.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录列出了在三个真实基准测试中使用的提示词，这些提示词均从已记录的需求中复制而来。 尖括号内的文本会在运行时填充，而 […] 表示此处省略了部分行。 在每个基准测试中，所有基于 LLM 的方法都使用相同的提示词，仅在与市场上下文之后接续的记忆块上存在差异（表 G.1）；而 § 4.4 中其他 LLM 则接收完全相同的提示词，无任何改动。 在每次运行和每个种子值下，从四个检索到的课程中生成的全部 16 个子集草案均已被记录，因此表 G.1 第二行中的方法仅在使用哪个草案或如何组合这些草案方面存在差异。 在 InvestorBench 和 ClassAlloc 中，一个决策由一条系统消息和一条用户消息组成的单次聊天完成构成，而无效回复则通过一次重试消息予以回应；在 PortBench 中，一个草案则是基准测试三阶段智能体的一次运行结果，且不允许重试。

paragraphs.en: A draft is one run of the benchmark’s native agent in three stages: market interpretation, signal generation and weight optimization. Each stage is one chat completion that returns a JSON object (JSON mode, at most 8,192 output tokens) and receives the output of the previous stage; the memory enters all three stages as the benchmark’s experience block, which holds the records selected by the method. The prompts below are those of PortBench-Raw for the balanced investor on 1 April 2022, for the draft with all four retrieved records; PortBench-Full extends the market-data table of stage 1 from eight assets to all eligible assets.
paragraphs.zh: 草案是指基准测试中本地智能体在三个阶段内的一次运行：市场解读、信号生成和权重优化。 每个阶段都是一次聊天完成操作，返回一个 JSON 对象（JSON 模式，最多 8,192 个输出标记），并接收前一阶段的输出；记忆将全部三个阶段的内容作为基准测试的经验块输入，其中包含方法选定的记录。 以下提示词是 PortBench-Raw 在 2022 年 4 月 1 日为平衡型投资者、使用所有四条检索记录的草案所采用的提示词；PortBench-Full 将第一阶段的市场数据表从八种资产扩展至所有符合条件的资产。

paragraphs.en: One record of the experience block , decoded. Each record describes an earlier decision of the benchmark’s agent (2015–2019): its allocation by asset class, a readout of its execution (net return J J , fee, turnover, concentration HHI, largest weight and fraction of assets held), public market features at the time, and the realized 20-day net return.
paragraphs.zh: 一条经验区块的记录已解码。 每条记录都描述了基准智能体在早期（2015–2019年）的一项决策：其按资产类别的配置情况、执行结果（净回报 J J、费用、换手率、集中度 HHI、最大权重及所持资产比例）、当时的公开市场特征，以及实现的20日净回报。

paragraphs.en: Replies of gpt-4.1-mini in this draft (seed 1). The environment turns the stage-3 scores into target weights, which are then projected to the investor’s mandate (Appendix D.3 ). Here, stage 3 gives the same score to the 93 assets without a sell signal and none to the four with one.
paragraphs.zh: 本草案中 gpt-4.1-mini 的回复（种子 1）。 环境将第 3 阶段的得分转换为目标权重，然后将其投影到投资者的授权范围（附录 D.3）。 在此，第 3 阶段对没有卖出信号的 93 项资产给予相同的得分，而对有卖出信号的 4 项资产则不给予任何得分。

paragraphs.en: Gains from memory on real markets remain to be shown. On PortBench and InvestorBench, MemTrial’s advantage over the experience-learning agents comes from abstaining: its values passed the trust test on fewer than 1% of the test decisions, and with the same anchor the baselines do as well (Appendix D.5 ). On ClassAlloc they passed on 15%, and the trusted drafts did not beat the anchored blend they replaced. This shows that MemTrial avoids the losses of acting on untested memory, not that memory improves real decisions; showing the latter may need more decisions, more informative experiences or tasks in which experiences matter more. When its values are trusted, MemTrial deploys the selected draft in full and so takes on its market exposure (Appendix E ); keeping part of the anchor even then is a natural extension.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆在真实市场中带来的收益仍有待证实。 在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 上，MemTrial 相对于经验学习智能体的优势源于其克制行为：它在不到 1% 的测试决策中通过了信任测试，而使用相同锚点的基线模型表现同样如此（附录 D.5）。 在 ClassAlloc 上，它们通过了 15% 的测试，且受信任的草案并未优于其所替换的锚定混合方案。 这表明 MemTrial 避免了基于未经检验的记忆采取行动所带来的损失，而非说明记忆本身能改善真实决策；要证明后者，可能需要更多决策、更具信息量的经验，或能让经验发挥更大作用的任务。 当其价值观获得信任时，MemTrial 会完整部署所选草案，从而承担相应的市场风险（附录 E）；即便如此，保留部分锚点仍是一种自然的延伸。

paragraphs.en: Pretraining exposure (look-ahead bias). The knowledge cutoff of gpt-4.1-mini (June 2024) is later than the whole InvestorBench test period and than 15 of the 20 PortBench test months, so the LLM may have seen these market outcomes during pretraining; the same holds for 50 of the 71 ClassAlloc test months. On ClassAlloc, the memory-free LLM beats 1/ N N by 0.08 pp per month before the cutoff and trails it by 0.08 pp after it (Appendix D.11 ), although 21 months are too few for this difference to be significant. Every LLM recalls dated outcomes from before its cutoff, and hiding the dates on ClassAlloc did not remove this pattern (Appendix D.14 ), but the LLM may still recognize a period from the returns it is shown; we did not hide the dates on PortBench and InvestorBench. This affects all LLM-based methods alike and leaves the paired comparisons fair, and PlantedMem, whose drafts do not depend on the date, is free of it; it may still change how much any LLM agent gains from memory.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练中的暴露（提前知晓偏差）。 gpt-4.1-mini 的知识截止时间为 2024 年 6 月，晚于整个 InvestorBench 测试周期以及 PortBench 20 个测试月份中的 15 个月，因此该 LLM 可能在预训练期间已经见过这些市场结果；对于 ClassAlloc 71 个测试月份中的 50 个月也是如此。 在 ClassAlloc 中，无记忆 LLM 在截止时间前每月比 1/ N N 高出 0.08 个百分点，而在截止时间后则低出 0.08 个百分点（附录 D.11），尽管 21 个月的样本量太少，不足以使这一差异具有显著性。 所有 LLM 都会回忆其截止时间之前的历史结果，在 ClassAlloc 中隐藏日期并未消除这一模式（附录 D.14），但该 LLM 仍可能根据所显示的收益率识别出某个时期；我们并未在 PortBench 和 InvestorBench 中隐藏日期。 这一问题对所有基于 LLM 的方法均同等影响，因此成对比较的公平性不受影响；而 PlantedMem 的草案不依赖日期，故不受此问题影响；但它仍可能改变任何 LLM 智能体通过记忆获得的收益程度。

paragraphs.en: Error rate of the trust test. The trust test is applied on every date to dependent scores of a selected learner (Appendix C.3 ), so its false-pass rate has no formal bound; we measure it instead (2–3% of decisions without signal). A sequential test with time-uniform error control on block or permutation scores would bound it.
paragraphs.zh: 信任测试的错误率。 信任测试在每次迭代中都会应用于所选学习者的依赖分数（附录 C.3），因此其误判率没有正式的上限；我们转而对其进行测量（无信号决策中的 2–3%）。 对块分数或排列分数进行时间均匀错误控制的序列测试可以为其设定上限。

paragraphs.en: Cost. MemTrial needs eight drafts per decision instead of one. The drafts run in parallel, so latency does not grow, but the LLM cost does; adaptive designs that spend more drafts only on dates where contributions are uncertain could reduce it.
paragraphs.zh: 成本。 MemTrial 每次决策需要八份草案，而不是一份。 这些草案并行运行，因此延迟不会增加，但 LLM 成本会增加；自适应设计可以仅在贡献不确定的日期上投入更多草案，从而降低成本。

sents.zh: 成本。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark protocols. PortBench scores each monthly decision as a separate episode that starts from the equal-weight book, so its costs are charged on the distance from that book rather than on actual turnover, and its experience pool is fixed before the first decision date, so learning happens in the credit rather than in the content of memory. Our InvestorBench task is a multi-asset adaptation of the benchmark’s single-stock task, with four stocks and cash. ClassAlloc’s class indices are equal-weighted and rebalanced daily, and its cryptocurrency class is left out. PlantedMem is semi-synthetic: its experiences act on the drafts through a simple tilt model (Appendix D.3 ), which is cleaner than the way real lessons act on an LLM, and each period’s outcome is known before the next decision.
paragraphs.zh: 基准协议。 PortBench 将每月的每个决策视为一个独立的回合，该回合从等权投资组合开始；因此，其成本是根据与该投资组合的距离计算的，而非基于实际交易量。此外，其经验池在第一决策日之前就已固定，因此学习过程发生在信用机制中，而非记忆内容本身。 我们的 InvestorBench 任务是基准协议中单股票任务的多种资产扩展版本，包含四只股票和现金。 ClassAlloc 的类别指数采用等权配置并每日再平衡，且其加密货币类别被排除在外。 PlantedMem 是半合成的：其经验通过一个简单的倾斜模型（附录 D.3）作用于草案，这种机制比真实经验对大型语言模型的作用更简洁；此外，每个周期的结果在下一个决策之前已知。
